About Axiom Space
-----------------

Axiom exists to create a thriving home in space that benefits every human, everywhere.  
  
The International Space Station's life is finite, and the world will soon be in need of a new space station. Axiom, whose leadership has been involved in every ISS mission since the program's inception, is taking on this challenge by supporting expanded utilization of the ISS today while creating the first international commercial space station to later host government astronauts, private companies, and individual explorers alike.  
  
Our low-cost Low Earth Orbit platform access and decades of human spaceflight management experience support the research, testing of exploration-enabling technologies, and in-space manufacturing that will create new opportunities for advanced industries, governments, and educators and enable future human space exploration.

What types of supply chain solutions does Softeon offer?

Softeon provides a comprehensive suite of supply chain solutions, including Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Distributed Order Management (DOM), and Resource Management Systems (RMS). These solutions are designed to optimize various aspects of the supply chain, from inventory management to order fulfillment and transportation logistics.

How can Softeon's Warehouse Management System (WMS) improve my operations?

Softeon's WMS enhances operational efficiency by automating warehouse processes, improving inventory accuracy, and optimizing space utilization. It offers real-time visibility into inventory levels and order statuses, enabling better decision-making. Additionally, the system supports advanced features like labor management, slotting optimization, and integration with other supply chain systems, resulting in reduced operational costs and improved service levels.

What industries does Softeon serve with its supply chain solutions?

Softeon serves a diverse range of industries, including retail, e-commerce, consumer goods, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing. Our solutions are tailored to meet the specific needs of each industry, helping businesses streamline their supply chain operations, enhance customer satisfaction, and drive profitability.

Can Softeon's solutions integrate with existing systems?

Yes, Softeon's solutions are designed with flexibility in mind and can easily integrate with existing enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, and other supply chain applications. This ensures a seamless flow of information across the supply chain, enabling organizations to leverage their current technology investments while enhancing overall operational efficiency.

What is Distributed Order Management (DOM) and how can it benefit my business?

Distributed Order Management (DOM) is a solution that helps businesses manage and fulfill orders from multiple sources, such as warehouses, stores, and third-party logistics providers. Softeon's DOM solution optimizes order fulfillment by determining the best location to ship from based on inventory availability, shipping costs, and delivery timelines. This leads to improved customer satisfaction through faster delivery times and reduced shipping costs.

How does Softeon support customers during the implementation of its solutions?

Softeon provides comprehensive support during the implementation of its solutions, including project management, training, and ongoing customer support. Our team works closely with clients to understand their unique requirements and customize the solutions accordingly. We also offer training sessions to ensure that users are well-equipped to utilize the software effectively, and our support team is available to assist with any issues that may arise post-implementation.

Building the new bank  
  
You may remember the name Williams & Glyn. It’s part of RBS and was known as the ‘alternative bank’ when it was last on the high street nearly 30 years ago. It introduced a number of new ideas to British banking, was famous for customer service and built a loyal following.  
  
As we embark on this remarkable journey, we are seeking people who put customers at the heart of everything they do, readily challenge the status quo and who enjoy working in a close-knit, agile culture.  
Williams & Glyn will be dedicated to outstanding service. Designed around the needs of customers, our branches will be at the heart of the bank, pursuing an ambitious mission to be open, honest and quite different from the competition.  
  
We’re working with a group of investors, led by Corsair Capital and Centerbridge Partner’s to float Williams & Glyn on the London stock exchange. You can find out more about the investors at www.rbs.com/williamsandglyn.  
  
We'll think differently and act differently, playing a positively active role in local communities, and making our people and account-holders proud.

How does Better Earth ensure the quality and compostability of its products?

Better Earth ensures the quality and compostability of its products through rigorous testing and certification processes. What are the environmental benefits of using compostable products from Better Earth?

Using compostable products from Better Earth helps reduce landfill waste, lower greenhouse gas emissions, and promote soil health. MDF stimulates new ideas, develops leaders, and provides common ground for solving problems and advancing issues by:  
  
Empowering leaders  
Strengthening communities  
Guiding public policy with trusted economic research  
Created in statute in 1978, MDF is a unique and trusted non-profit 501(c)(3) corporation. MDF works statewide across all sectors.

-------------------

Sound Transit is transforming how the Central Puget Sound region moves by planning, building and operating regional transit systems that give millions of riders an alternative to sitting in traffic. As the agency prepares for nearly a million new Central Puget Sound residents by 2040, transit services are expanding to meet today’s growing needs.  
  
Thanks to voter approval of the largest mass transit expansion in the region’s history, Sound Transit’s light rail system will grow to four times the size it is today. When complete, the 116-mile light rail system will stretch from Everett to Tacoma and connect major job and population centers in Seattle including South Lake Union, Seattle Center, Ballard and West Seattle. It will also extend east to Bellevue, Redmond, Issaquah and Mercer Island.  
  
As Sound Transit grows, we seek innovative, technical and creative professionals who are ready to come on board and make a difference. Career opportunities include information technology, finance, construction management and engineering positions. Apply today at www.soundtransit.org/jobs.

Rich Pelt serves as the Senior Director of Vaccines CMC Regulatory Affairs at Pfizer, where he leverages over three decades of extensive leadership experience in biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical regulatory affairs. Since Pfizer's acquisition of Wyeth Pharmaceuticals in 2009, Rich has been instrumental in shaping the strategic direction of the company’s vaccine portfolio, particularly in the context of global health challenges.

His expertise in international and multifunctional project management allows him to effectively coordinate with various health authorities, including the US FDA, EMA, and regulatory bodies in Canada, Japan, and Australia. Rich’s strategic planning and execution skills are critical in ensuring compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and facilitating smooth technology transfers.  
  
In addition to his regulatory acumen, Rich excels in risk assessment and management, ensuring that potential challenges are identified and mitigated early in the development process. His comprehensive understanding of chemical engineering principles and validation processes further enhances his ability to guide complex vaccine development projects. By fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary teams, Rich not only drives regulatory success but also contributes to Pfizer's mission of delivering safe and effective vaccines to improve global health outcomes.

This data-driven approach allows businesses to understand their customers better, optimize marketing strategies, and enhance overall customer experience.

What industries does Direct Partners support?

Direct Partners supports a diverse range of industries, including retail, finance, healthcare, and technology. Their expertise in systems integration and marketing technology enables them to tailor solutions that meet the unique needs of each industry. Whether it's enhancing customer engagement in retail or improving patient outreach in healthcare, Direct Partners leverages its industry knowledge to drive meaningful results for clients.

Can Direct Partners assist with marketing technology integration?

Yes, Direct Partners offers comprehensive marketing technology integration services. They help businesses streamline their marketing efforts by integrating various technologies, such as CRM systems, email marketing platforms, and data analytics tools. This integration ensures that clients can efficiently manage their marketing campaigns, track performance, and gain valuable insights into customer behavior, ultimately leading to more effective marketing strategies.

What is the approach of Direct Partners towards customer experience?

Direct Partners believes that a positive customer experience is crucial for building lasting relationships. Their approach involves understanding customer needs and preferences through data analysis and feedback. By creating personalized marketing strategies and optimizing customer interactions across various touchpoints, Direct Partners helps businesses enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty, ultimately driving long-term success.

How can businesses benefit from the partnership between Direct Partners and RAPP?

The partnership between Direct Partners and RAPP combines extensive expertise in direct marketing and customer engagement strategies. Businesses can benefit from a broader range of services, including enhanced customer intelligence, innovative marketing solutions, and integrated technology platforms. This collaboration allows clients to leverage the strengths of both companies, resulting in more effective marketing campaigns and improved customer relationships.

About Pioneer Institute for Public Policy Research
--------------------------------------------------

Pioneer’s mission is to develop and communicate dynamic ideas that advance prosperity and a vibrant civic life in Massachusetts and beyond.  
  
Pioneer’s vision of success is a state and nation where our people can prosper and our society thrive because we enjoy world-class options in education, healthcare, transportation and economic opportunity, and where our government is limited, accountable and transparent.  
  
Pioneer values an America where our citizenry is well-educated and willing to test our beliefs based on facts and the free exchange of ideas, and committed to liberty, personal responsibility, and free enterprise.  
  
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PioneerInstitute  
Twitter: @PioneerBoston  
Visit our website to sign up for email updates, learn about upcoming events and programs, and support our work: www.pioneerinstitute.org  
  
Overview:  
  
Pioneer promotes high-quality public schools, affordable healthcare, effective government, economic opportunity and social mobility by publishing research and engaging the public through media campaigns, educational forums, and information sessions with influential thought leaders.  
  
PioneerEducation supports excellent school options for all children, world-class liberal arts-based academic standards, and accountability for results in public education.  
  
Pioneer Health advances high-quality and cost-effective care through price transparency, reforms to public programs, and innovation in healthcare delivery and treatments.  
  
PioneerPublic promotes government that delivers high-quality public services, focuses on core functions, and is transparent to Massachusetts residents.  
  
PioneerLegal pursues reforms in Pioneer’s core policy areas that can take effect only through public interest law initiatives.  
  
Pioneer Opportunity advocates policies to expand opportunity across the Commonwealth, and reforms to transportation, housing, taxation, and regulation that will increase Greater Boston’s competitiveness.

Breast center: State-of-the-art screening, evaluation, treatment and support

Skilled care unit: Ideal environment for stabilized patients who need an extra measure of care  
  
Wound Care Center: Healing wounds under the care of specialists for 10 years  
  
Laboratory services: Accredited by the College of American Pathology  
  
Primary Stroke Center: Joint Commission Primary Stroke Certification; telemedicine stroke technology

About Edward Lowe Foundation
----------------------------

Ed and Darlene Lowe established the Edward Lowe Foundation in 1985 to leverage entrepreneurship as a strategy for economic growth and community development. In contrast to most U.S. foundations, which are grant-giving entities, we are an operating foundation that funds its own programs.  
  
Our entrepreneurship initiatives are focused on second-stage companies — growth-oriented firms that have moved beyond startup but haven’t yet reached maturity. Our peer learning, leadership education and strategic information programs are geared to help these companies continue growing. We also educate communities about the unique challenges second-stagers face, how to work with them — and how to develop the kind of culture they need to flourish.  
  
To scale our impact, the foundation delivers its programs to second-stagers through other entrepreneur support organizations, which includes chambers of commerce, small business development centers, technology councils and economic development agencies. Although many programs are conducted on our partners’ turf, such as PeerSpectives CEO roundtables and Economic Gardening, we host leader retreats and facilitator training at Big Rock Valley (BRV), our headquarters in southwest Michigan.  
  
BRV is also integral in our land stewardship initiatives. A 2,000-acre property comprised of woodlands, wetlands and prairies, BRV’s diverse habitats support a wide variety of species, many of which are endangered or threatened. To preserve BRV’s environmental integrity, the foundation employs a number of innovative land management practices. In addition, we allow researchers to use the property for studies that can expand the knowledge base of conservation science.

What is Unity and what industries does it serve?

Unity is the world's leading platform for creating and operating real-time 3D (RT3D) content. It serves a wide range of industries, including gaming, film, automotive, architecture, engineering, and education. Unity provides tools and solutions that enable creators to build immersive experiences, from video games to architectural visualizations and interactive simulations.

What are the key features of Unity Pro?

Unity Pro is a powerful game engine that offers a variety of features, including advanced graphics rendering, real-time physics, a robust asset store, and a comprehensive suite of tools for both 2D and 3D development. It also includes collaboration features, cloud services, and analytics tools that help developers optimize their projects and enhance user engagement.

Can Unity be used for non-gaming applications?

Yes, Unity is not limited to game development. It is widely used in various non-gaming applications such as architectural visualization, virtual reality (VR) experiences, augmented reality (AR) applications, training simulations, and interactive storytelling. Its versatility makes it a popular choice for creators across multiple industries.

What types of support and resources does Unity offer for developers?

Unity provides extensive support and resources for developers, including comprehensive documentation, tutorials, and a vibrant community forum. Additionally, Unity offers training programs, webinars, and certification courses to help users enhance their skills. For enterprise customers, Unity provides dedicated support and consulting services to assist with project development.

Is Unity suitable for beginners in game development?

Yes, Unity is suitable for beginners as well as experienced developers. The platform features a user-friendly interface and a wealth of learning resources, including beginner-friendly tutorials and sample projects. Unity's community and asset store also provide access to pre-built assets and tools that can help newcomers get started quickly in game development.

What are the licensing options available for Unity?

Unity offers several licensing options to cater to different needs. The free version, Unity Personal, is available for individual developers and small studios with revenue under a certain threshold. For larger organizations or those requiring advanced features, Unity Pro and Unity Enterprise licenses are available, offering additional tools, services, and support tailored for professional development.

What hasn't?  
Everything you’ve come to expect from Agencyport…

\- Our commitment to helping customers navigate the increasingly complex waters of P&C insurance and the technology that powers it remains at our core  
  
We love this business, and we’ve never been more optimistic about its future and the opportunities ahead for all of us.  
  
Take a look at our new home at Duck Creek Technologies. We think you’ll like what you see.

What services does Quantcast offer for digital advertising?

Quantcast offers a comprehensive Demand-Side Platform (DSP) that utilizes advanced AI technology to predict audience behaviors and optimize advertising campaigns. Our services include audience targeting, campaign management, real-time bidding, and performance measurement, allowing advertisers to reach the right audience at the right time for maximum impact.

How does Quantcast's AI technology enhance advertising campaigns?

Quantcast's AI technology analyzes vast amounts of data to identify patterns and predict which audiences are most likely to engage with your ads. This predictive capability enables advertisers to optimize their campaigns in real-time, ensuring that their ads are served to the most relevant users, ultimately leading to improved conversion rates and ROI.

What industries does Quantcast support with its advertising solutions?

Quantcast supports a wide range of industries, including retail, automotive, travel, finance, and entertainment. Our platform is designed to cater to the unique needs of each industry, providing tailored solutions that help businesses effectively reach and engage their target audiences.

Can Quantcast help with measuring the effectiveness of advertising campaigns?

Yes, Quantcast provides robust measurement tools that allow advertisers to track the performance of their campaigns in real-time. Our analytics dashboard offers insights into key metrics such as impressions, clicks, conversions, and audience engagement, enabling businesses to make data-driven decisions and refine their strategies for better results.

What is programmatic advertising, and how does Quantcast fit into it?

Programmatic advertising is the automated buying and selling of online ad space using technology and data. Quantcast operates within this ecosystem by providing a DSP that leverages AI to optimize ad placements and targeting. Our platform streamlines the process, allowing advertisers to efficiently reach their desired audiences while maximizing their advertising budgets.

How can I get started with Quantcast's advertising solutions?

Getting started with Quantcast is easy. You can visit our website to request a demo or sign up for an account. Our team will guide you through the setup process, help you define your advertising goals, and provide support as you launch and manage your campaigns. We also offer resources and training to ensure you get the most out of our platform.

We target small-to-midsized accounts and have the flexibility to offer terms for businesses with poor loss histories, high-risk venues, and new or high-hazard operations. AWS China offers a variety of AI and ML services that enable developers and businesses to build intelligent applications. About MU Career Center

The University of Missouri (MU) Career Center offers a broad range of services and resources to assist students in their career-related needs. We assist students in finding majors, exploring career options, seeking student employment, drafting a resume or cover letter, developing job search strategies, building interview skills, and much more.  
  
The MU Career Center works closely with all departmental career services offices on campus to provide coordinated services to all Mizzou students. Find out more information about the departmental Career Services offices on campus by checking out our Showcase Pages! We are your resource for all things career-related at Mizzou!  
  
MU Career Center Services: Students may visit the MU Career Center between 9am – 4pm, Monday through Friday in person or via Zoom for one-on-one assistance with a trained Career Specialist. CNP is committed to offering the highest quality products and service on time and at a competitive cost. We have a proven track record as innovators in the nutritional, natural and organic food industries. Let us share our 35+ years of experience and knowledge to create the best tasting, nourishing and convenient food and beverage products for your customers.  
  
CNP has always been at the leading edge of developmental trends in foods and food ingredients. CNP invented and patented the natural processes for rice syrup, rice syrup solids, and rice milk in the 80's. CNP pioneered the packaging of natural and organic aseptic beverages in the 90's. CNP has been a proponent of and leader in the nutritional, natural and organic food movements since their founding.  
  
CNP owns and operates a state-of-the-art aseptic processing and packaging facility in Lathrop, CA. However, our business does not stop within the walls of our facility. We always strives to deliver the highest customer satisfaction ratings in our industry. Some of the ways we are doing this is by bringing innovative solutions to the marketplace. Since our inception more than 30 years ago, CNP has developed many new products that have been introduced to the marketplace. We continually reinvest in our facility, our people and our systems to give our customers the competitive edge they need to be leaders and increase business profitability. We are a client-focused organization and informed business partner with our clients.

SymphonyAI Sensa, a SymphonyAI division, empowers banks and financial institutions with a complete picture of customer, third party, and user behavior to discover crime, risk, and competitive opportunity through unparalleled, predictive insights.  
  
Sensa is the leader in the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade intelligent applications. These applications combine uniquely state-of-the-art AI, semi and supervised learning creating superior prediction and discovery, industry-leading explainability, and intuitive, context-specific user-experiences.  
  
SensaAML™ uses an innovative approach to combat financial crime by discovering hidden patterns in financial data and identifying the behaviors of criminal activity and the laundering networks. The solution develops and deciphers customer data by integrating and predicting nefarious behavior and identifying unknown criminal threats. A combination of Graph Machine Learning, behavior maps, inference relationships, longitudinal behavior, and risk are applied in a single orchestration to discover the DNA of complex financial crime. The outcome delivers a virtual, risk-based customer view represented in a simple to understand, and easy-to-use business user environment that seamlessly integrates into the Financial Institution’s existing processes.

What types of allergy treatments does Allergy Therapeutics offer?

Allergy Therapeutics specializes in the research and development of innovative allergy treatments, including allergen immunotherapy vaccines. These treatments are designed to help patients manage their allergic reactions by gradually desensitizing them to specific allergens. Our product range includes both subcutaneous and sublingual immunotherapy options, catering to various allergens such as pollen, dust mites, and animal dander.

How does allergen immunotherapy work?

Allergen immunotherapy works by exposing the patient to gradually increasing amounts of the allergen, which helps the immune system build tolerance over time. This process can lead to a reduction in allergy symptoms and may even provide long-term relief after treatment has ended. The therapy is tailored to each individual, ensuring that the dosage and duration of treatment are appropriate for their specific allergies.

Are Allergy Therapeutics' treatments safe for all age groups?

Yes, our allergy treatments are designed to be safe for a wide range of age groups, including children and adults. However, it is essential for patients to consult with a healthcare professional to determine the most suitable treatment plan based on their medical history and specific allergies. Our team is committed to ensuring the safety and efficacy of our treatments for all patients.

What industries does Allergy Therapeutics support?

Allergy Therapeutics primarily supports the healthcare industry, particularly in the fields of immunology and allergy management. We collaborate with healthcare providers, research institutions, and pharmaceutical companies to advance the understanding and treatment of allergies. Our goal is to improve patient outcomes through innovative therapies and comprehensive education on allergy management.

How can I find more information about clinical trials for Allergy Therapeutics' products?

For more information about ongoing clinical trials related to our allergy treatments, you can visit our website's dedicated clinical trials section or contact our customer service team. We regularly update our website with information about current studies, eligibility criteria, and how to participate. Additionally, we encourage patients to discuss clinical trial opportunities with their healthcare providers.

What is the process for getting started with allergy immunotherapy?

To get started with allergy immunotherapy, the first step is to consult with a qualified healthcare professional who specializes in allergy treatment. They will conduct a thorough evaluation, including allergy testing, to identify the specific allergens affecting you. Based on the results, they will develop a personalized treatment plan that may include allergen immunotherapy. Once the plan is established, the healthcare provider will guide you through the administration process and monitor your progress throughout the treatment.

About HELP Pain Medical Network
-------------------------------

HELP is a compassionate, evidence-based, outcomes-oriented Interdisciplinary Pain Rehabilitation Program. Our full-time, co-located, licensed staff is focused on one thing: assisting those with chronic pain return to a meaningful life.  
  
Our Mission: To Reduce the Impact of Chronic Pain on Patients and Society  
  
We offer a variety of treatment methods that range from direct hands-on rehabilitation services given in our facilities to remote training, coaching, and medication management delivered over the phone. No matter what stage of the rehabilitation process you are in, our flexible services are designed to help you make progress towards a better life.  
  
We start by listening. We know that every patient who comes to us as a survivor of chronic pain is unique. That’s why, before we begin treatment, make a recommendation, or write up a report, we listen to your story. As a result, our approach to pain management is customized to fit your needs, your injury, and your recovery. So you get the help you need from people who care.

Her key projects often involve implementing innovative training programs that emphasize mindfulness and teamwork, ensuring that employees feel valued and engaged. Jackie’s strategic approach includes providing consultation and coordination across departments to address difficult situations and foster open communication.  
  
Her expertise in pre-opening initiatives and budget management further underscores her commitment to creating a thriving workplace. What is floor plan financing and how does it work?

Floor plan financing is a type of short-term loan that auto dealers use to purchase their inventory. It allows dealers to finance the vehicles on their lot, enabling them to maintain a diverse selection of cars without tying up their capital. With Lever, dealers can access flexible financing solutions that are tailored to their specific needs, ensuring they have the necessary funds to stock their lots and meet customer demand.

What types of dealers does Lever support?

Lever primarily supports independent auto dealers across various segments, including used car dealerships, specialty vehicle dealers, and more. Our services are designed to cater to the unique needs of these dealers, providing them with the financial tools necessary to thrive in a competitive market. By joining Lever, dealers become part of a community that prioritizes their success and growth.

What are the benefits of partnering with Lever for floor plan financing?

Partnering with Lever offers numerous benefits, including competitive interest rates, flexible repayment terms, and a streamlined application process. Our fintech solutions are designed to simplify the financing experience, allowing dealers to focus on their business rather than financial complexities. Additionally, Lever's commitment to supporting independent dealers fosters a collaborative environment where dealers can share insights and best practices.

How does Lever ensure transparency in its financing solutions?

Lever is dedicated to transparency in all its financial dealings. We provide clear terms and conditions, ensuring that dealers understand their financing options and obligations. Our team is always available to answer questions and clarify any aspects of the financing process. We believe that open communication is key to building trust and long-lasting relationships with our dealers.

Can Lever assist with refinancing existing floor plan loans?

Yes, Lever offers refinancing options for dealers looking to improve their current floor plan financing terms. Our team will work closely with you to assess your existing loans and identify opportunities for better rates or terms. Refinancing can help reduce monthly payments or free up cash flow, allowing dealers to invest more in their business operations.

What industries beyond auto dealerships can benefit from Lever's financing solutions?

While Lever primarily focuses on the auto finance sector, our flexible financing solutions can also be adapted for other industries that require inventory financing, such as recreational vehicle (RV) dealers, marine dealers, and powersport dealers. Our goal is to provide tailored financial solutions that help businesses manage their inventory effectively, regardless of the specific industry.

About Redbrick Paper

About us:  
  
Redbrick is the multi-award-winning official student newspaper of the University of Birmingham, established in 1936. We publish fortnightly print editions throughout the academic year and update our website (www.redbrick.me) with new content every day.  
  
Redbrick's twelve sections are entirely run, edited and designed by students, for students. Our sections are as follows:  
  
News, Comment, Culture, Music, Film, Television, Gaming, Food&Drink, Travel, Life&Style, Sci&Tech and Sport.  
  
How to get involved:  
  
Students can get involved by purchasing a membership from the Guild of Students website (www.redbrick.me/join) and then joining the Redbrick Hub and individual section groups on Facebook. About Visit St. Pete Clearwater
-------------------------------

The Tourist Development Council (TDC) and staff of the Visit St. Petersburg/Clearwater (VSPC) Area Convention & Visitors Bureau (CVB) are responsible for making recommendations to the Board of County Commissioners (BCC) on matters relating to the Tourist Development Tax. This tax is used to strengthen the local economy and increase employment through the ongoing promotion and development of tourism, Pinellas County's major industry.  
  
VSPC Area Convention & Visitors Bureau is a department of Pinellas County Government and is the official tourism marketing and management organization for the St. Petersburg/Clearwater Area. The CVB is charged with enhancing the county's economy by increasing direct visitor expenditures and job development, training and retention in the tourism industry. The organization works domestically and internationally to develop and enhance sustainable tourism for the St. Petersburg/Clearwater area in both the leisure and meetings markets and targets consumers, travel media, the travel industry, meeting and conference planners, sports promoters and film producers with research driven marketing programs touting beaches, sports, arts and culture and nature-based opportunities. The CVB also leads a community-based team to market the benefits of tourism to local residents while working with varied interests to assist in the development of new attractions and the redevelopment of others.

About Shaker Village of Pleasant Hill
-------------------------------------

Shaker Village of Pleasant Hill is a landmark destination that shares 3,000 acres of discovery in the spirit of the Kentucky Shakers. With 34 original Shaker structures, the site is home to the country’s largest private collection of original 19th century buildings and is the largest National Historic Landmark in Kentucky. Demonstrating a commitment to community, sustainability and ingenuity, Shaker Village embraces three pillars rooted in time-honored Shaker legacies, including balanced preservation and conservation; engaged learning and exploration; and warm, spirited hospitality. Onsite services at Shaker Village of Pleasant Hill include overnight accommodations, dining, beverage and catering services, three craft shops, exhibitions in historic buildings, a farm and garden area, the Dixie Belle Riverboat and 1,200 acres of restored native prairie.

About Backbase
--------------

Backbase enables banks to break free from the constraints of legacy IT systems and embrace a new-generation engagement banking platform.  
  
Our whitelabel platform enables banks to gradually replace or decompose disparate legacy systems and construct a modern journey orchestration architecture around customer needs. These incremental changes allow banks to streamline business critical customer journeys across all touch points while eliminating silos and empowering both customers and employees at their unique pace and priority.  
  
Furthermore, a unique “buy plus build'' operating model enables banks to gain speed and flexibility, allowing them to accelerate in their modernization journey. Adopting powerful out-of-the-box platform features and customer journeys into their existing tech ecosystem, enables banks to start delivering immediate value. At the same time the platform’s capability to coexist in open polyglot architectures gives developers the freedom and flexibility to build unique, differentiating value, rather than building the basic functionalities from scratch.  
  
With Backbase, banks can truly unlock the potential of customer-centricity and lead the way in shaping the future of banking. We help banks re-architecting banking around their customers through omni-channel engagement orchestration.

About Ed Cooley

Ed Cooley is an American basketball coach known for his tireless dedication to developing young athletes on and off the court. With an unwavering commitment to his players' personal growth, Cooley has garnered respect and admiration throughout the basketball community. His coaching style blends intensity, creativity, and a genuine passion for the game, creating an environment that fosters success and cultivates winning teams.  
  
Born on September 6, 1969, in Providence, Rhode Island, Cooley's love for basketball started at an early age. Growing up in the heart of a basketball-crazed city, he quickly fell in love with the game, immersing himself in all aspects of it. From playing in neighborhood pickup games to watching college basketball on television, Cooley's passion for hoops was palpable.  
  
After attending Central High School, Cooley honed his skills as a point guard at Stonehill College, located in Easton, Massachusetts. It was during his time as a student-athlete that he discovered his passion for coaching, realizing how much he enjoyed inspiring and guiding his teammates on the court. This realization marked the beginning of his journey towards becoming one of the most respected basketball coaches in the country.  
  
Cooley's coaching career began at the collegiate level, where he started as an assistant coach at Stonehill College. He then moved on to coach at Brandeis University, another Division III school. Throughout these early coaching years, Cooley understood the importance of hard work and determination, virtues he instills in his players to this day. His ability to connect with athletes, help them unlock their potential, and build strong relationships has been key to his success.  
  
In 2006, Cooley got his big break when he joined the coaching staff at Boston College as an assistant coach. Here, he learned from experienced coaches and further refined his coaching philosophy. His relentless work ethic and ability to connect with players and families earned him a reputation as a rising star in the coaching world.  
  
In 2011, Cooley landed his dream job as the head coach of the Providence College men's basketball team. Taking the reins of a program with a rich history, he embraced the opportunity to lead and guide young athletes towards success. Cooley's impact on the team was immediately felt, as he transformed the Friars into formidable competitors in the highly competitive Big East Conference.  
  
One of Cooley's greatest strengths as a coach is his ability to adapt to different players' needs and playing styles. He places a strong emphasis on player development, nurturing talents and helping them reach their full potential. Many of his players have gone on to play professionally, a testament to his ability to prepare them for the next level.  
  
Off the court, Cooley is a mentor and role model to his players, constantly stressing the importance of education, character development, and community involvement. He believes in empowering his athletes to be strong leaders, instilling in them values that extend far beyond the basketball court. Cooley is deeply invested in his players' success, both as athletes and as individuals, and works tirelessly to ensure they are well-rounded and prepared for life beyond the game.  
  
Coaching is not just a job for Ed Cooley; it is his life's calling. His infectious energy and genuine love for the game inspire his players to push themselves harder and strive for greatness. Cooley's impact extends beyond the court, leaving a lasting legacy of leadership, perseverance, and the pursuit of excellence. As a respected figure in American basketball coaching, Ed Cooley continues to mold and shape the future of the sport, one player at a time.

About Hantec Markets
--------------------

The Hantec Group was founded in Hong Kong in 1990. With its focus on becoming a multinational financial broker, Hantec had expanded its operations and reputation across Hong Kong, Mainland China and Taiwan before being listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2000.  
  
Over the years, the Hantec Group has operated in a variety of fields from real estate, to cultural innovation businesses and even to water plantations in Asia. In line with the vision of our founders, Hantec continued to develop its global presence and is proudly represented in twelve countries collecting numerous awards along the way.  
  
By 2008, the brand ‘Hantec Markets’ was born in Sydney, Australia. This was closely followed in 2010 by the broker’s flagship office in London, United Kingdom. The launch of the London office signalled the beginning of a period of rapid growth, expanding the group’s operations across seven regulated entities and eighteen offices helped position Hantec Markets as one of the world’s most entrusted brokers.  
  
In 2020, the Hantec Group made the strategic decision to partition into Eastern and Western divisions, headquartered in Hong Kong and London, respectively. Representing the Western division of the Hantec Group, Hantec Markets’ regulation in the United Kingdom (FCA), Jordan (JSFC) and Mauritius (FSC) leverage synergies to help clients worldwide trade safely on the most popular and liquid financial markets in the world. The Hantec Group’s Eastern division comprises of regulation in Australia (ASIC), New Zealand (FMA), Japan (FSA) and Hong Kong (CGSE) which allows Hantec the depth to focus on providing clients with security and confidence while delivering a competitive product offering.  
  
Trust through Transparency: Hantec Markets’ goal is to provide an unrivalled trading experience that demonstrates fairness and transparency in every aspect of its delivery to maintain a stable and secure environment for its customers to learn, develop and trade.

What types of financial services does Hantec Markets offer?

Hantec Markets provides a wide range of financial services, including online forex trading, liquidity solutions, and brokerage services for asset managers. They cater to both retail and institutional clients, offering access to various financial instruments such as forex, commodities, and indices. Additionally, they provide white label solutions and partnership opportunities for businesses looking to enter the financial services market.

Which trading platforms are supported by Hantec Markets?

Hantec Markets supports several trading platforms to meet the diverse needs of its clients. The primary platforms include MetaTrader 4, which is widely recognized for its user-friendly interface and advanced trading tools, and Currenex, known for its high-speed execution and deep liquidity. Clients can choose the platform that best fits their trading style and requirements.

How does Hantec Markets ensure the security of client funds?

Hantec Markets prioritizes the security of client funds by implementing robust measures, including segregated accounts for client deposits, which ensures that client funds are kept separate from the company's operational funds. They are also regulated by relevant authorities, which mandates adherence to strict financial standards and practices. Additionally, they utilize advanced encryption technologies to protect client data and transactions.

What industries does Hantec Markets serve?

Hantec Markets serves a variety of industries within the financial sector. Their primary focus is on forex trading and brokerage services, but they also cater to asset managers, introducing brokers, and other financial institutions. By offering liquidity solutions and partnership opportunities, Hantec Markets supports businesses looking to enhance their trading capabilities and expand their market reach.

Can I open a white label account with Hantec Markets?

Yes, Hantec Markets offers white label solutions for businesses interested in establishing their own brokerage services. This allows companies to leverage Hantec's trading infrastructure, liquidity, and technology while branding the service as their own. The white label program is designed to provide flexibility and support for businesses of various sizes, enabling them to enter the financial market with a comprehensive trading solution.

What partnership opportunities are available with Hantec Markets?

Hantec Markets provides various partnership opportunities, including introducing broker programs and affiliate partnerships. These programs are designed to help individuals and businesses earn commissions by referring clients to Hantec Markets. Partners benefit from competitive commission structures, marketing support, and access to advanced trading tools, making it an attractive option for those looking to monetize their network in the financial services industry.

About EducationSuperHighway
---------------------------

EducationSuperHighway is a national non-profit with the mission to close the digital divide for the 18 million households that have access to the Internet but can't afford to connect. We focus on America's most unconnected communities, where more than 25% of people don't have Internet.  
  
From 2012-2020 we led the effort that closed the classroom connectivity gap. In 2013, only 10% of students had access to digital learning in their classrooms. Today, thanks to an unprecedented bi-partisan effort by federal, state, and school district leaders, supported by K-12 advocacy organizations, the classroom connectivity gap is closed - 47 million students are connected, and 99.3% of America's schools have a high-speed broadband connection.

What types of products does PureCare offer for creating a healthy sleep environment?

PureCare specializes in a variety of sleep products designed to enhance your sleep environment. How do PureCare's mattress and pillow protectors contribute to better sleep?

PureCare's mattress and pillow protectors are designed to provide a barrier against allergens, dust mites, and moisture, which can disrupt sleep. By maintaining a clean and healthy sleep environment, these products help improve overall sleep quality and hygiene.

What is Celliant technology, and how does it benefit sleep?

Celliant technology is a unique textile innovation used in PureCare's Body Chemistry Recovery Hybrid Pillows. It is designed to convert body heat into infrared energy, which can promote increased blood flow, enhance tissue oxygenation, and aid in muscle recovery. This technology helps users experience deeper, more restorative sleep by supporting the body's natural recovery processes during the night.

Yes, PureCare offers products specifically designed for temperature regulation. Their SUB-0° Cooling Hybrid Pillows utilize FRíO technical textiles that actively wick away moisture and heat, helping to maintain a comfortable sleeping temperature. This is particularly beneficial for individuals who tend to sleep hot or experience night sweats, as it promotes a cooler and more restful sleep experience.

What industries does PureCare serve with its sleep solutions?

PureCare serves a variety of industries that prioritize health and wellness, including hospitality, healthcare, and retail. By focusing on creating a healthy sleep environment, PureCare supports the well-being of individuals across these sectors.

Are PureCare products safe for sensitive skin or allergies?

Absolutely! PureCare prioritizes the health and safety of their customers by using hypoallergenic materials in their products. What is Couchbase Capella and how does it benefit developers?

Couchbase Capella is a fully managed cloud database platform designed for modern applications. It allows developers to build and deploy applications quickly by providing a flexible, scalable, and high-performance database solution. Capella supports both document and key-value data models, enabling developers to work with data in a way that best suits their application needs. Additionally, its built-in features like automatic scaling, backup, and recovery help ensure that applications remain available and performant, allowing developers to focus on building innovative features rather than managing infrastructure.

What types of applications are best suited for Couchbase's NoSQL database technology?

Couchbase's NoSQL database technology is particularly well-suited for applications that require high scalability, low latency, and flexible data models. Common use cases include real-time analytics, content management systems, mobile applications, and e-commerce platforms. The ability to handle large volumes of unstructured or semi-structured data makes Couchbase an excellent choice for applications in industries such as gaming, retail, finance, and healthcare, where rapid data access and processing are critical.

Can Couchbase Capella integrate with existing SQL databases?

Yes, Couchbase Capella can integrate with existing SQL databases through various methods, including data migration tools and APIs. This allows organizations to leverage their existing SQL data while taking advantage of Couchbase's NoSQL capabilities. Additionally, Couchbase provides a SQL-like query language called N1QL that enables users to perform complex queries on JSON documents, making it easier for teams familiar with SQL to transition to a NoSQL environment without a steep learning curve.

What industries does Couchbase support with its database solutions?

Couchbase supports a wide range of industries, including finance, retail, healthcare, gaming, telecommunications, and more. Each of these industries benefits from Couchbase's ability to handle large volumes of data, provide real-time analytics, and ensure high availability. For example, in finance, Couchbase can be used for fraud detection and risk management, while in retail, it can enhance customer experiences through personalized recommendations and inventory management.

What are the advantages of using a cloud database like Couchbase Capella?

Using a cloud database like Couchbase Capella offers several advantages, including reduced operational overhead, automatic scaling, and enhanced security features. Organizations can benefit from a pay-as-you-go pricing model, which allows them to scale resources up or down based on demand without the need for significant upfront investment in hardware. Additionally, Capella provides built-in security features such as encryption, access controls, and compliance certifications, ensuring that data is protected while meeting regulatory requirements.

How does Couchbase ensure data consistency and reliability in its database solutions?

Couchbase ensures data consistency and reliability through a combination of features such as multi-dimensional scaling, automatic replication, and built-in conflict resolution. It employs a distributed architecture that allows for data to be replicated across multiple nodes, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance. Couchbase also supports strong consistency models, enabling developers to choose the level of consistency that best fits their application requirements. This approach helps maintain data integrity while providing the performance needed for modern applications.

About Edelweiss Financial Services
----------------------------------

Edelweiss is one of India’s leading diversified financial services Group. Edelweiss offers a large range of products and services spanning across asset classes and consumer segments. Its businesses are broadly divided into Credit including Retail Finance and Debt Capital Markets, Commodities, Financial Markets, Asset Management and Life Insurance. The group’s research driven approach and proven history of innovation has enabled it to foster strong relationships across corporate, institutional and individual clients. The Life Insurance, Retail Finance including Housing Finance, Mutual Fund and Retail Broking businesses – both online and offline formats, have paved the way for Edelweiss to cater to the large retail client segment. Edelweiss’ presence now covers 240 offices in 125 cities including eight international offices with 5,555 employees catering to over 572,000 clients across various businesses in retail and wholesale segments. Over the years, Edelweiss progressively widened its services basket by moving into adjacent business spaces. Edelweiss was a purely capital market-focused player a few years ago; this business accounts for only about a third of its revenues today. As Edelweiss continues to broad base revenues, a rising proportion of growth will be derived from its Credit, Asset Management, Commodities and Insurance businesses. Edelweiss possessed a balance sheet size at the end of FY 12 of over INR 145 Bn with a net worth of over INR 28 Bn. Edelweiss focuses on low gearing that provided the organisation with sufficient headroom to fund growth without comprising its balance sheet integrity. Edelweiss’ risk mitigation practices are strengthened through timely investments in people, processes and IT capabilities on the one hand, and credible governance practices stewarded by an industry-renowned Board on the other. Edelweiss cultivates a culture of entrepreneurship and ownership among its people. The Group continues to invest in developing leadership and managerial talent across the organization through a four-tier system of identifying, nurturing and mentoring leaders. Fountainhead, Edelweiss’ state-of-the-art leadership centre in Alibaug, is among few such centres in the Indian Financial Services industry, promoting among others, a culture of training and development across the group. The Edelweiss brand is a much respected brand enjoying widespread recognition due to consistent investment in diverse set of brand building efforts spanning both conventional and unconventional channels. The ‘Ideas create, values protect’ tagline underlines all branding efforts. A testament to the quality of the reputation being enjoyed by Edelweiss is the fact that Superbrands India has recognized Edelweiss as the Business Superbrand in the year 2011.

About Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd
------------------------------------------

Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd. (MOFSL) was founded in 1987 as a small sub-broking unit, with just 2 people running the show. Focus on a customer-first attitude, ethical and transparent business practices, respect for professionalism, research-based value investing, and implementation of cutting-edge technology has enabled us to blossom into a 10,500+ member team.  
  
Today we are a well-diversified financial services firm offering a range of financial products and services such as Private Wealth, Retail Broking and Distribution, Institutional Broking, Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Commodity Broking, Currency Broking, and Home Finance.  
  
We have a diversified client base that includes retail customers (including High Net worth Individuals), mutual funds, foreign institutional investors, financial institutions, and corporate clients. We are headquartered in Mumbai and, as of September 2022, had a network spread over 550 cities and towns comprising 2500+ Business Locations operated by our Business Partners, us, and 5.2 Million+ customers.  
  
Research is the solid foundation on which MOFSL advice is based. Almost 10% of revenue is invested in equity research, and we hire and train the best resources to become our advisors. At present we have 25+ research analysts researching over 250 companies across 20 sectors. From a fundamental, technical, and derivatives research perspective, Motilal Oswal’s research reports have received wide coverage in the media.  
  
Our consistent efforts towards quality equity research have reflected in an increase in the ratings and rankings across various categories in the AsiaMoney Brokers Poll over the years. We have also been awarded the Best Performing Equity Broker (National) at the CNBC TV18 Financial Advisor Awards for five years in a row & got inducted into the ‘Hall of Fame’ at the 10th Financial Advisory Awards 2019.

Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.

With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.  
  
Life  
  
Our Story  
Founded more than 35 years ago in Ireland, Planet now operates in over 120 markets and employs around 3,000 staff in more than 40 offices worldwide.  
  
Our software and payment technology helps businesses unlock the benefits of a more connected and digital world and delivers a more enjoyable customer experience at the same time.  
  
We have an exciting journey ahead of us as we look to deliver connected commerce that puts the customer experience first.  
  
Our People

We are dedicated to simplifying, improving and positively surprising the businesses and people we work with.  
  
We’re focused on innovation to ensure that our products and services are always ahead of the competition.  
  
We are committed to attracting the widest range of people and providing an environment where they can flourish.  
If you want to join us, take a look at our open jobs.  
  
What we do  
We’re here to help our customers and partners make the most of the connected commerce revolution.  
  
We’ve built our reputation for putting our partners first over 30 years, which has helped us become the trusted integrated software and payments partner for the world’s greatest brands and financial services institutions.  
  
Our technology and payments platforms help our customers and partners deliver a more enjoyable experience for shoppers, guests and consumers.  
  
And additional value added services in marketing consultancy, data, intelligence and insight unlock more revenue.

About Juel Burnette

As the Branch Manager at 1st Tribal Lending, a division of Mid America Mortgage, Inc., Juel Burnette plays a pivotal role in advancing homeownership opportunities for Tribal communities across the nation through the HUD Section 184 Indian Home Loan program. With a deep commitment to community outreach and a strong understanding of the unique challenges faced by Tribal members, Juel is dedicated to fostering relationships with Tribes, Tribal Designated Housing Entities (TDHEs), and individual members. Under his leadership, the South Dakota team is focused on delivering tailored financial solutions that empower Tribal communities to achieve their homeownership dreams.  
  
Juel’s expertise in banking and new business development, combined with his skills in negotiation and fundraising, enables him to effectively advocate for the needs of his clients. He is adept at navigating the complexities of government programs and has a proven track record of successfully implementing initiatives that enhance access to the HUD 184 program. His strategic approach to marketing and event planning has also been instrumental in raising awareness about the benefits of the program, ensuring that Tribal members are informed and equipped to take advantage of these valuable resources.  
  
In addition to his professional responsibilities, Juel is passionate about giving back to the community and actively engages with nonprofits that support housing initiatives. His commitment to fostering economic growth within Tribal communities is evident in every project he undertakes, making him a respected leader in the industry. For those seeking guidance on the HUD 184 program or looking to explore homeownership options, Juel invites you to connect and discover how 1st Tribal Lending can assist in making homeownership a reality.

Data shows that today’s teams want smarter, simpler slush. SurgiSLUSH™ generates 96% clinical support post-evaluation. Informed slush users recognize clear clinical & economic advantages.  
  
Sealed Sterile Security:  
SurgiSLUSH™ users lock out airborne contaminants and water-avid pathogens with sealed ChillVault™ containers. Users add hours of sealed protection and delete the extended ambient exposure required by traditional slush units.  
And ChillVault™ containers enable visual confirmation of sterile barrier integrity before every use for optimal sterile technique.  
  
Streamlined Workflow:  
SurgiSLUSH™ automates always-expert, ready-to-use slush. SurgiSLUSH™ users erase variable quality and distracting slush maintenance during challenging, complex cases. These days, teams appreciate no-fuss slush.  
  
Multi-Room Supply:  
Our users supply more slush with less labor, less waste & less equipment. SurgiSLUSH™ freezers reduce per-room equipment costs by 25%- 50%. Today’s teams get far more value & efficiency with sealed, auto-maintained supply.  
  
MARKET INFO:  
US clinical teams use over 1,200,000 liters of sterile slush annually to topically cool and reduce an organ's need for oxygen, slow cellular damage and provide surgeons additional time for treatment in cardiac, organ procurement, transplant, urology, plastic and other complex surgeries.  
  
C Change Surgical holds over 30 US and foreign patents for sterile fluid temperature control and clinical automation. We licensed our first fluid control technology to a global, public company in 2010.

About Nederlandse Voedsel En Warenautoriteit - NVWA

About the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority  
  
The task of the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority is to protect human and animal health. It monitors food and consumer products to safeguard public health and animal health and welfare. The Authority controls the whole production chain, from raw materials and processing aids to end products and consumption.  
  
The Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority is an independent agency in the Ministry of Economic Affairs and a delivery agency for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport.  
  
The three main tasks of the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority are: supervision, risk assessment and risk communication. Other important activities are incident and crisis management and policy advice for the Minister of Economic Affairs. A significant part of its work involves liaising with other ministries. Maintaining international contacts is also of vital importance.

About RetailNext
----------------

RetailNext is the worldwide market leader and expert in retail analytics for brick-and-mortar retail, delivering real-time analytics that enable retailers and manufacturers to collect, analyze, and visualize in-store data. The patent-pending solution uses best-in-class video analytics, Wi-Fi detection, on-shelf sensors, and data from point-of-sale systems and other sources to automatically inform retailers about how people engage with their stores. The highly scalable RetailNext platform easily integrates with promotional calendars, staffing systems, and even weather services to analyze how internal and external factors impact customer shopping patterns – providing retailers the ability to identify opportunities for growth, execute changes, and measure success.  
  
RetailNext measures more than one billion shopping trips per year by collecting data from nearly 100,000 sensors in retail stores and analyzing trillions of data points annually. Headquartered in San Jose, CA, RetailNext is a growing global brand operating in more than 40 countries.

.

¿Qué es Amnistía Internacional y cuál es su misión?

Amnistía Internacional es una organización no gubernamental (ONG) que trabaja para promover y proteger los derechos humanos en todo el mundo. Su misión es garantizar que todas las personas disfruten de los derechos establecidos en la Declaración Universal de los Derechos Humanos y otros instrumentos internacionales. A través de la investigación, la defensa y la movilización de la opinión pública, Amnistía Internacional busca poner fin a las violaciones de derechos humanos y promover la justicia social.

¿Cómo puedo involucrarme como voluntario en Amnistía Internacional España?

Existen diversas formas de involucrarse como voluntario en Amnistía Internacional España. Puedes unirte a uno de nuestros grupos locales, participar en campañas, organizar eventos o colaborar en actividades de sensibilización. Para comenzar, visita nuestra página web y completa el formulario de inscripción para voluntarios. También ofrecemos oportunidades de formación para que puedas adquirir las habilidades necesarias para ser un activista efectivo.

¿Qué tipo de campañas realiza Amnistía Internacional en España?

Amnistía Internacional España lleva a cabo campañas sobre una amplia variedad de temas relacionados con los derechos humanos, incluyendo la libertad de expresión, los derechos de las mujeres, la lucha contra la tortura, y la defensa de los derechos de los refugiados. Estas campañas pueden incluir acciones de sensibilización, peticiones, movilizaciones y actividades educativas para informar al público sobre la situación de los derechos humanos en España y en el mundo.

¿Cómo puedo hacer una donación a Amnistía Internacional España?

Puedes hacer una donación a Amnistía Internacional España a través de nuestra página web. Ofrecemos varias opciones de donación, incluyendo donaciones únicas y donaciones mensuales. También puedes optar por hacer una donación en honor a alguien o en memoria de un ser querido. Tu contribución ayuda a financiar nuestras investigaciones, campañas y actividades de defensa de los derechos humanos.

¿Qué recursos educativos ofrece Amnistía Internacional España?

Amnistía Internacional España proporciona una variedad de recursos educativos para estudiantes, docentes y cualquier persona interesada en aprender sobre derechos humanos. Estos recursos incluyen guías, materiales didácticos, talleres y actividades interactivas. También organizamos eventos y conferencias para fomentar el diálogo y la reflexión sobre temas de derechos humanos en el ámbito educativo.

¿Cómo se asegura Amnistía Internacional de la veracidad de la información que publica?

Amnistía Internacional se compromete a la investigación rigurosa y a la verificación de la información. Nuestro equipo de investigadores trabaja en el terreno y utiliza diversas fuentes, incluyendo testimonios de víctimas, informes de organizaciones locales y datos de organismos internacionales. Además, seguimos un estricto código de ética y procedimientos de revisión para garantizar que la información que publicamos sea precisa y confiable.

About Anomaly
-------------

Anomaly is streamlining healthcare payments for providers, payers, and patients—reducing healthcare costs and complexity.  
  
Over $300B is lost every year to avoidable denials and payment errors, impacting the affordability of healthcare. Anomaly is working with the country’s largest healthcare companies to enable instant, accurate healthcare payments. Our AI-enabled products integrate in the claims flow, analyzing billions of transactions to predict and prevent payment issues before they occur.  
  
Smart Response reduces denials and administrative costs by giving providers a real-time response identifying actionable claim errors—so they can avoid denials before the claims even get to the payer. This solution is powered by our claim prediction engine, which predicts with over 99% precision the exact claim line payment and associated denial reason. Instant Pay (coming soon) will further streamline payments by enabling providers to immediately get paid when they submit their claims to the payer.  
  
Our fast-growing team brings together top engineering and healthcare talent committed to making healthcare more efficient and affordable. We recently announced $17M in Series A and seed funding from Redesign Health and other top tech and healthcare investors.  
  
Interested in joining us? Visit findanomaly.com to see open roles.

About Third Rock Ventures
-------------------------

We discover, launch and build great companies based on bold ideas that meet at the intersection of science, strategy, business and medicine – where transformational science meets operational reality – providing the best opportunity to make a dramatic difference in patients’ lives.  
  
THE THIRD ROCK TEAM  
Our team has a proven record of translating disruptive technologies into valuable business enterprises. Working closely with leading scientific and business visionaries as well as industry partners, we identify opportunities to change the future of medicine and rigorously vet those ideas through our discovery process to develop the vision, strategy and plan needed to succeed.  
  
A FORMULA FOR INNOVATION  
We only invest in the best of those ideas. We are actively involved in the early stages of our companies’ development, typically serving as members of the founding management teams, to build a strong foundation, put in place the right people and culture, and set the companies on a path to scientific and operational excellence.  
  
We believe in the companies we launch and make big initial investments, often complemented by strategic alliances, to enable our companies to advance life-changing therapies, devices and diagnostics. By creating value for patients, we create value for our investors.

About Desert Angels
-------------------

Founded in 2000, the Desert Angels is a Tucson-based organization of accredited investors that seeks opportunities to invest in regional startup and early-stage companies. We represent a network of over 100 active angel investors, who have since invested $60million into 132 portfolio companies and 10 Sidecar funds.  
  
The Desert Angels have consistently been recognized as one of the most active angel groups in the country and, in 2019 was ranked #1 in the southwest and #8 in the country according to the 2019 ARI HALO report. (https://angelresourceinstitute.org/research-reports.php). The Desert Angels is a charter member of the Angel Capital Association, which is the trade association of angel investment groups in North America and today represents over 240 angel investor groups and funds. The Desert Angels is also a member of the Angel Syndication Network, a network of angel groups actively engaged in collaborating for deal syndication.  
  
Membership in the Desert Angels gives you the opportunity to be more innovative, insightful, efficient, and connected as you build and manage your portfolio. Benefits include: access to qualified deals and an annual Sidecar fund; tools and best practices to help you track and manage your investments; advocacy, connection and syndication; and membership to ACA and ASN.

What types of companies does Desert Angels typically invest in?

Desert Angels focuses on investing in startup and early-stage companies across various industries, including technology, healthcare, consumer products, and renewable energy. The organization seeks innovative businesses with strong growth potential and a solid business model, particularly those based in the Tucson region or the broader Southwestern United States.

How can startups apply for funding from Desert Angels?

Startups interested in securing funding from Desert Angels can apply through our website by submitting a detailed business plan and executive summary. We recommend that applicants clearly outline their business model, market opportunity, and financial projections. Once submitted, our team will review the application and may invite the founders for a presentation to our network of investors.

What is the typical investment range that Desert Angels provides?

Desert Angels typically invests between $50,000 and $500,000 in each startup, depending on the company's needs, stage of development, and growth potential. The exact amount can vary based on the specific investment opportunity and the terms negotiated during the funding process.

What support does Desert Angels offer beyond financial investment?

In addition to financial support, Desert Angels provides valuable mentorship and guidance to the companies in which we invest. Our network of experienced investors often shares their expertise in areas such as business strategy, marketing, and operations. We also facilitate connections with other industry professionals and resources that can help startups grow and succeed.

Is Desert Angels open to investors outside of Tucson?

Yes, Desert Angels welcomes accredited investors from outside Tucson who are interested in supporting regional startups. Our network is designed to connect investors with promising companies, regardless of their location. However, we prioritize investments in businesses that have a significant impact on the local economy and community.

How does Desert Angels evaluate potential investment opportunities?

Desert Angels employs a thorough evaluation process for potential investment opportunities. This includes assessing the business model, market potential, competitive landscape, and the founding team's experience and capabilities. We also consider financial metrics and projections, as well as the overall alignment of the opportunity with our investment strategy and goals.

Baidu was founded in 2000 by Internet pioneer Robin Li, creator of visionary search technology Hyperlink Analysis, with the mission of providing people with the best way to find information and connect users with services.

Over the past decade we have strived to fulfill this mission by listening carefully to our users’ needs and wants. To provide intelligent, relevant search results for the tens of billions of queries that are entered into our search platform every day, we focus on powering the best technology optimized for up-to-date local tastes and preferences. Our deep understanding of Chinese language and culture is central to our success and this kind of knowledge allows us to tailor our search technology for our users’ needs.  
  
We provide our users with many channels to find and share information. In addition to our core web search product, we power many popular community-based products, such as Baidu PostBar, the world’s first and largest Chinese-language query-based searchable online community platform, Baidu Knows, the world’s largest Chinese-language interactive knowledge-sharing platform, and Baidu Encyclopedia, the world’s largest user-generated Chinese-language encyclopedia, to name but a few. Beyond these marquee products we also offer dozens of helpful vertical search-based products, such as Maps, Image Search, Video Search, News Search, and many more. We power these through our cutting-edge technology, continually innovating to enhance these services. Our new Box Computing Open Platform brings users deep-linked content and even applications they can use directly through their search box.  
  
Baidu continues to innovate to meet Internet users' increasingly diverse tastes. With our goal of best serving the needs of our users and customers with intelligent and relevant solutions, we look forward to a robust future.

About Tom Prichard

As the Executive Director of Sudan Sunrise, Tom Prichard plays a pivotal role in fostering initiatives that promote education, reconciliation, and sustainable development in Sudan and South Sudan. With a deep commitment to social justice and community empowerment, Tom collaborates closely with both Sudanese and South Sudanese Christians and Muslims to cultivate projects that bridge divides and build a more harmonious future. One of his flagship initiatives, Kush State University (KSU), exemplifies this mission. Located in the Nuba Mountains, KSU is an ambitious endeavor aimed at providing higher education opportunities in a region historically underserved by educational institutions. Currently, the university boasts a diverse student body of 196 nursing students and 75 students pursuing automotive studies, reflecting Tom's dedication to addressing critical workforce needs and fostering economic development.  
  
Tom's expertise in social entrepreneurship and philanthropy enables him to effectively mobilize resources and engage stakeholders in meaningful dialogue. His skills in volunteer recruiting and non-profit board development are instrumental in building a robust network of supporters and advocates for Sudan Sunrise's mission. Additionally, his experience in workshop facilitation and pastoral care allows him to create safe spaces for dialogue and healing, essential for reconciliation in a region marked by conflict. Through his leadership, Tom Prichard is not only transforming lives through education but also nurturing a culture of cooperation and understanding that is vital for the long-term stability and prosperity of Sudan and South Sudan.

Duffy’s Sports Grill is based in Palm Beach County, Florida, and operates 34 full-service, casual-dining restaurants throughout Florida. The company has become a regional market leader known for top-quality casual dining with an emphasis on fresh ingredients and grilled items in a distinctive sports atmosphere. Guests will find more than 80 televisions broadcasting endless sports entertainment in each location. Guests also rave about Duffy’s MVP loyalty program which offers free meals and exclusive discounts to its members just for dining with them. Duffy’s Sports Grill is the largest family-owned and operated restaurant group in the Southeast. After the company’s founder, Paul Emmett, lost his battle to cancer in 2015, the family established the Duffy’s Foundation in his memory. About Redwood Credit Union
--------------------------

Redwood Credit Union (RCU) is a full-service financial cooperative, assisting consumers and small business owners with achieving their financial goals and dreams since 1950. Unlike financial institutions whose purpose is to create profit for stockholders, RCU is a financial cooperative which means our focus is simply to serve the Members who participate in our cooperative.  
  
At RCU you'll find a wide variety of products and services designed to meet your financial needs. You'll also discover a financial institution that truly cares about the people who do business with us. Each Member actually owns part of the Credit Union and has a voice in what we do and how we do it.  
  
We continue today to build upon a solid philosophical and business foundation that was started in 1950 – treating Members with respect and personal care while offering unbeatable value.  
  
Federally insured by NCUA.  
Equal housing lender.  
  
\*\*\*  
  
Non-deposit investment products and services are offered through CUSO Financial Services, L.P. (“CFS”), a registered broker-dealer (Member FINRA www.finra.org /SIPC www.sipc.org ) and SEC Registered Investment Advisor. Products offered through CFS: are not NCUA/NCUSIF or otherwise federally insured, are not guarantees or obligations of the credit union, and may involve investment risk including possible loss of principal. Investment Representatives are registered through CFS. Redwood Credit Union has contracted with CFS to make non-deposit investment products and services available to credit union members.  
  
Investment representatives at Redwood Credit Union are licensed to transact securities business in CA.
