About Minkema College
---------------------

Minkema College, located at Minkemalaan 1 in Woerden, Utrecht, is a prominent public educational institution that offers a diverse range of academic programs tailored to meet the needs of its students. With a commitment to fostering an inclusive learning environment, Minkema College caters to various educational pathways, from vocational training to the rigorous demands of a gymnasium curriculum. This broad educational spectrum ensures that students can pursue their individual interests and career aspirations while receiving a high-quality education.  
  
The college prides itself on its dedicated faculty, who are instrumental in shaping the academic journey of each student. For those interested in the teaching staff, a comprehensive Minkema College teachers list is available on their official website, providing insights into the qualifications and expertise of the educators who guide students through their studies. The school's approach emphasizes not only academic excellence but also personal development, equipping students with the skills necessary for success in a rapidly changing world.  
  
In addition to its robust curriculum, Minkema College actively engages with the local community and industry, fostering partnerships that enhance the educational experience. This connection to the real world prepares students for future challenges, making them competitive candidates in the job market. Overall, Minkema College stands out as a nurturing and dynamic environment where students can thrive academically and personally, paving the way for their future endeavors. For more information, visit their website at www.minkema.nl.

About Habitat
-------------

Habitat is an iconic homeware and furniture retailer that was launched on the British high street in 1964, and has been challenging the way people style and shop for their homes ever since. Habitat continues to create good design that’s useful, affordable and distinctive.  
  
We recognise that today there are more brands than ever selling furniture, but here’s why we’re still going strong:  
  
Original design is the most important thing we do – Almost every Habitat product has been created by a Habitat designer; hours of work go into making each piece useful, beautiful and long-lasting.  
  
We reach every corner of the world – We’ve always travelled the world to find the best partners and to be inspired by how other people live.  
  
We’re committed to quality at every price point – No matter how small or how big the piece, we apply rigorous quality standards to everything we sell. We obsess over materials, finishes and construction so our customers can be confident their new product is fit for purpose, well designed and fairly priced.  
  
We’re accessible to all – We have three London showrooms, Minis across the country, a collection at 900+ stockists, and hassle-free delivery throughout the UK.  
  
We’ve been imagining life as it should be since 1964 – From the wok to the duvet, paper pendants to chicken bricks, and all our iconic catalogues in between, Habitat has had a unique and prolific impact on the way the British live.  
  
We’re always interested to hear from people who live and breathe great design, and who want to partner with or be part of a progressive and original accessories, homeware and furniture brand.  
  
So give us a shout if you’re a motivated and inspired because we like thinkers who are both commercial and creative.  
  
We’re here – just as we have been, for half a century.

About International Women's Forum
---------------------------------

The International Women’s Forum is an invitation-only, membership organization comprised of more than 7,000 diverse and accomplished women from 33 nations on six continents.  
  
IWF’s mission is to support the women leaders of today and tomorrow. We build better leadership across careers, continents and cultures by connecting accomplished women both locally and globally. Members include Fortune 500 executives, government leaders from the local to sovereign level, international nonprofit leaders, and luminaries from the academy, arts, and sciences. Each year, IWF hosts two international conferences that bring together these thought leaders to examine critical issues of the day within a local context and through a women’s lens.  
  
The Leadership Foundation, Inc. (the Foundation), established in 1990, is a supporting organization of IWF and the mechanism by which IWF members advance the next generation of women leaders. The Foundation seeks to increase the number of women in the C-Suite and positions of influence globally and fulfills this mission through two central programs – the Fellows Program and the Women Athletes Business Network (WABN) Program.  
  
IWF and the Foundation also provide intensive leadership training programs for women at every stage of professional development through its IWF Intensives Program.

About Amtech Solutions, Inc.

Amtech Solutions, Inc., headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is a premier full-service architectural, engineering, and building envelope consulting firm with a legacy of design excellence and unwavering client satisfaction since its inception in 1982. With over 35 years of extensive experience, Amtech specializes in the assessment, testing, and repair/replacement design of various building types, catering to both local and national clients across public and private sectors. The firm’s diverse team comprises architects, engineers, registered roof and exterior wall consultants, and reserve specialists, all dedicated to delivering innovative solutions tailored to each project’s unique requirements.  
  
Amtech’s comprehensive suite of services includes building envelope consulting, structural assessments, roofing design, and facility condition assessments, ensuring that clients receive expert guidance throughout the lifecycle of their projects. The firm employs cutting-edge technologies and methodologies to conduct thorough evaluations and implement effective repair strategies, enhancing the durability and performance of building systems. With strategically located offices in Dallas, Austin, Rio Grande Valley, Corpus Christi, Houston, Las Vegas, Denver, and Washington, DC, Amtech is well-positioned to serve a wide range of industries, including commercial, residential, educational, and governmental sectors.  
  
By prioritizing quality, safety, and sustainability, Amtech Solutions, Inc. has established itself as a trusted partner in the architectural and engineering landscape, committed to fostering long-term relationships and ensuring the integrity of the built environment for years to come.

About Gene B. Glick Company
---------------------------

From our apartment communities to our extensive philanthropic endeavors, our business is family. The Gene B. Glick Company believes in people – our residents, our employees and the communities we serve. We’re doing our part to advance our neighborhoods, schools and environment.  
  
Founded in Indianapolis in 1947, Glick is one of the largest privately held real estate management and development firms in the U.S., with more than 20,000 multifamily units across 13 states.  
  
The Gene B. Glick Company strives each and every day to set the standard for the multi-family housing industry. We set ourselves apart by providing apartment homes and customer service of the highest caliber and creating value for our residents, employees and neighborhoods. Through our charitable outreach, we work to enhance the communities we serve.  
  
Our Values  
Our company’s reputation was built on founder Gene Glick’s dedication to integrity, quality construction, excellent service and superbly maintained communities. His family carries on that heritage by investing in organizations and opportunities that make the world a better place. We operate the company according to an unwavering set of principles:  
  
• We value our residents.  
• We enhance the lives of our residents by serving them with respect, care and dignity.  
• We value our reputation.  
• We conduct business in a manner consistent with the highest ethical and moral standards.  
• We value social responsibility.  
• We contribute our time and resources to making our local communities better places in which to live.  
• We value our employees.  
• We maintain a corporate culture that demonstrates to each employee that “Our business is family.”  
• We strive for excellence in everything we do.

Retail Asset Management, Inc. specializes in the management, leasing, and development of shopping centers and commercial retail properties. What services does Retail Asset Management, Inc. offer for shopping center management?

Founded by former MTV President Tony DiSanto and staffed with a deep bench of industry innovators, DIGA productions are marked by a rebellious and sometimes subversive pop sensibility that resonates with youthful audiences worldwide. Past hits include the series Teen Wolf & Scream while current productions run the gamut from real estate lifestyle programs to gameshows to scripted horror formats, including “50 States of Terror”, executive produced by Sam Raimi for Jeffrey Katzenberg’s QUIBI.  
  
DIGA’s goal is to bring ideas to life by any means necessary, from the traditional scripted and reality development processes, to digital incubation, to acquisitions of IP or the creation of original IP through its book and podcasting divisions, to a variety of creative and business partnerships with talent, studios, media companies and brands. There are no “rules”- the path taken is that which gets the story told.  
  
Since its launch in January 2011 DIGA has developed and produced content for A&E, CW, History, Lifetime, CMT, MTV, NBCU Studios, VH1, Bravo, MTV2, LOGO, Disney Channel, MTV International, Oxygen, YouTube, Nickelodeon, Go90 and many others.  
  
DIGA Studios is a wholly owned subsidiary of ALLYANCE Media Group, with more information available at www.digastudios.com.

About The VMC Group
-------------------

The VMC Group, headquartered in Bloomingdale, New Jersey, is a leading manufacturer specializing in engineered shock and vibration isolation systems and seismic restraint devices. With a commitment to safety and innovation, The VMC Group stands out as the first company in the industry to achieve the status of a 'Certified Seismic Qualification Agency.' This distinction underscores its expertise in seismic engineering services, particularly in the realm of structural analysis and seismic shake testing, adhering to the stringent standards set by AC-156.  
  
Accredited by the International Code Council’s (ICC) International Accreditation Service (IAS) as a Product Certification Agency (PCA-127), The VMC Group is the only certification agency dedicated to the special seismic certification of non-structural building components and their mounting configurations. This accreditation not only highlights the company's adherence to best practices but also assures clients that their products undergo rigorous evaluation and continuous monitoring by a globally recognized body.  
  
The VMC Group serves a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, education, and commercial construction, providing essential solutions that enhance the resilience of buildings in seismic-prone areas. With facilities strategically located in Bloomingdale, NJ, Houston and Dallas, TX, Sacramento, CA, Caguas, PR, and Dubai, UAE, The VMC Group is well-positioned to meet the needs of its clients worldwide. The company is always on the lookout for talented professionals to join its dynamic team, inviting interested candidates to explore career opportunities on their website. Through its innovative products and commitment to excellence, The VMC Group continues to set the standard in seismic safety and vibration control.

About ISWA International Solid Waste Association
------------------------------------------------

The International Solid Waste Association (ISWA) is a global, independent and non-profit making association, working in the public interest to promote and develop sustainable waste management. ISWA has members in more than 80 countries and is the only worldwide association promoting sustainable and professional waste management.  
  
ISWA's objective is the worldwide exchange of information and experience on all aspects of waste management. The association promotes the adoption of acceptable systems of professional waste management through technological development and improvement of practices for the protection of human life, health and the environment as well as the conservation of materials and energy resources.  
  
ISWA is active in a variety of areas, including conferences, meetings, certification programs, information development and dissemination, and technical assistance on a global scale.  
  
ISWA is open to individuals and organizations from the scientific community, public institutions and public and private companies from all over the world working in the field of and interested in waste management.  
  
Being part of ISWA gives you an unparalleled access to international organizations. Through our Working Groups, we help these international organizations form policy by supplying technical papers and opinions regarding waste practices. ISWA is the only worldwide waste organization, which allows you to net-work with professionals, companies and institutional representatives.

About Touro College
-------------------

Touro College, headquartered in New York City, is a distinguished Jewish-sponsored independent institution dedicated to higher and professional education. Established with the mission to enrich Jewish heritage while serving the broader American community, Touro College currently enrolls approximately 19,000 students across its various schools and divisions. The institution is accredited by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education, ensuring that it meets rigorous academic standards. This accreditation extends to Touro College's branch campuses and instructional sites not only in New York but also in international locations such as Berlin, Jerusalem, and Moscow.  
  
In addition to its main campus, Touro University California and its Nevada branch are accredited by the Accrediting Commission for Senior Colleges and Universities of the Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC). The establishment of Touro College Los Angeles (TCLA) in Fall 2005 further expands the college's reach, providing additional educational opportunities within the WASC region. Touro College is committed to fostering a diverse educational environment, with a faculty that includes a wide array of experienced professionals. For those interested in the academic offerings, a comprehensive Touro College teachers list is available, showcasing the expertise and qualifications of the faculty members dedicated to student success. Through its commitment to academic excellence and community service, Touro College continues to play a vital role in the landscape of higher education.

Le centre d'escalade Roc Gyms est un immeuble aménagé et dédié à l'escalade intérieure. Fondé par François Guy Thivierge en 1993, premier centre du genre au Québec, le Roc Gyms offre une méga salle d'escalade de 40 pieds (12.2 mètres) de hauteur permettant de s'initier et de se perfectionner. Les 75 parcours codés de couleurs sont modifiés régulièrement. Il offre aussi deux salles de blocs avec une caverne immense.  
  
Fondé en 1989, le club école l'Ascensation fait la promotion et l'organisation d'activités d'aventure en montagne et de formation l'escalade intérieure, sur rocher et de glace. Son siège social est situé au Roc Gyms. Nous sommes membre d'Aventure Écotourisme Québec (AEQ), de la Fédération Québécoise de la Montagne et de l'Escalade (FQME), de l'Office du Tourisme de Québec (OTQ), de l'Office du Tourisme de Charlevoix et des Entreprises Canadiennes Indépendantes.

About Boston Ballet
-------------------

Since 1963, Boston Ballet’s internationally acclaimed performances of classical, neo-classical, and contemporary ballets, combined with a dedication to world class dance education and community initiative programs, have made the institution a leader in its field, with a 53-year history of promoting excellence and access to dance.  
  
Under the leadership of Artistic Director Mikko Nissinen and Executive Director Meredith Max Hodges, the Company maintains a diverse repertoire, ranging from full-length ballets to new works by some of today's finest choreographers. Boston Ballet's second company, Boston Ballet II, is comprised of dancers who gain experience by performing with the Company and independently, presenting special programs to audiences throughout the Northeast.  
  
Boston Ballet School, the official school of Boston Ballet, has a long-standing dedication to providing exceptional dance education and ballet training to students across three studios in Boston, Newton, and the North Shore. Led by Director Margaret Tracey, the School reaches more than 5,000 students (toddler to adult) each year through its four core programs: Children’s Program, Classical Ballet Program, Adult Dance Program, and Pre-Professional Program.  
  
Boston Ballet’s Department of Education and Community Initiatives (ECI) provides programming, events, and activities that connect the community to dance. ECI reaches more than 4,000 individuals in Boston, North Shore, and the surrounding communities each year through Citydance, ECI on Location, Adaptive Dance, and other community programs.

About Wahanda
-------------

Eight years ago, Wahanda began a journey with a dream to give customers a better way to book their hair, beauty and spa services. However, the Wahanda group were using five different consumer brand names across 10 countries. We decided the time had come to unite under one brand name. We chose Treatwell because it captures the spirit that has always been at the heart of what we do, the belief that beauty was for everyone.  
  
On January 18th 2016, Wahanda changed its name to Treatwell.  
https://www.treatwell.com/  
  
Treatwell, formerly called Wahanda, is the largest hair and beauty bookings website in Europe. We’re an eclectic group of 500 people working in offices throughout Europe, with over 20,000 local partners. It amounts to an around-the-clock beauty bookings platform that puts customers and salon managers in control. It lets you book at times and prices that suit you and gives you all the style know-how you need to look and feel amazing. Salons have a platform to market their businesses and fill their quieter times using Treatwell's bespoke salon management software.  
  
We're more than a smarter booking platform. We're the place where you can express yourself, every day.

About The Sacramento Bee
------------------------

History  
Published: Monday, Dec. 04, 2006  
Founded in 1857, The Sacramento Bee is the flagship of the 30 daily and almost 50 non-daily newspapers owned by The McClatchy Company. The third-largest newspaper corporation in the country in terms of circulation, McClatchy prints more than 3.2 million papers each day, read by millions more all over the world via a covey of Web sites on the Internet.  
  
On February 3, 2007, The McClatchy Company and The Sacramento Bee celebrated their 150th Anniversary. Over the years, McClatchy-owned papers have won hundreds of journalism awards, including 73 Pulitzer Prizes. Of that number, 15 have been coveted Gold Medals for Public Service.  
  
  
The Sacramento Bee Company overview  
  
The Bee's circulation area covers approximately 12,000 square miles: south to Stockton, north to the Oregon border, east to Reno and west to the San Francisco Bay Area. Over the years, circulation of both the daily and Sunday papers has grown steadily, and the paper remains at the forefront of newspaper technology and publishing. The bundle of ink and newsprint that arrives on time every morning reflects the efforts of more than 1,000 employees and 1,100 independent newspaper carriers.

About Warrington Guardian Series (Newsquest North West Ltd)
-----------------------------------------------------------

Nicola has been Editor of the Warrington Guardian for eight years and is only the second woman to hold the post since the paper started 160 years ago.  
She also edits the Warrington Midweek and warringtonguardian.co.uk.  
In 2006 she was appointed Group Editor of Newsquest Cheshire, and in December 2008 added the Wirral Globe and the Leigh Journal titles to her portfolio. She is now responsible for 12 weekly newspapers and 10 websites, plus the Wirral Lifestyle magazine.  
She has an editorial staff of 50.  
In 2009 she reorganised the editorial departments and introduced central subbing for the Cheshire/Merseyside titles which are all now produced from Warrington.  
She continues to work with the other editors and their teams who are based in Northwich, Sale, St Helens, Leigh and Wirral to produce market-leading newspapers and websites.  
Nicola takes an active role in the company’s journalism training acting as an invigilator and assessor for workshops and refresher courses for trainees before taking their NCE.  
She is a member of the Society of Editors.

About Rush University Medical Center
------------------------------------

RUSH University Medical Center is an academic medical center that includes a 671-bed hospital serving adults and children, the 61-bed Johnston R. Bowman Health Center and RUSH University. RUSH University is home to one of the first medical colleges in the Midwest and one of the nation's top-ranked nursing colleges, as well as graduate programs in allied health, health systems management and biomedical research. The Medical Center also offers more than 70 highly selective residency and fellowship programs in medical and surgical specialties and subspecialties.  
  
For more than 170 years, RUSH has been leading the way in developing innovative and often life-saving treatments. Today, RUSH is a thriving center for basic and clinical research, with physicians and scientists involved in hundreds of research projects developing and testing the effectiveness and safety of new therapies and medical devices.  
  
In addition to its mission in patient care, education and research, RUSH maintains a strong commitment to the community. RUSH reaches out to the Chicago community through such offerings as the RUSH Community Services Initiatives Program, an umbrella for several student-led outreach programs designed to address the social and health care needs of residents in neighboring communities.

How does nextSource help organizations with risk mitigation and compliance?

nextSource offers specialized services focused on Risk Mitigation and Compliance to help organizations navigate the complexities of contingent workforce management. This includes ensuring adherence to labor laws, managing vendor risks, and implementing best practices for compliance. Their team conducts thorough assessments and provides actionable insights to minimize potential risks associated with contingent labor.

Can nextSource assist with Statement of Work (SOW) management?

About Lynk
----------

Lynk (formerly UbiquitiLink) has successfully completed initial space-to-ground tests of the fundamental technology required to provide connectivity for cell phone users virtually anywhere on the globe using low-earth-orbit nanosatellites. Lynk’s technology allows standard cell phones, without any changes in hardware or software, to be connected everywhere, seamlessly shifting from a terrestrial tower to a satellite overhead.  
  
The Lynk network will provide connectivity with existing cell phones in the most isolated areas, providing a safety net to people in remote locations, whether it’s on the high seas or high in a mountain range. The network will also give relief agencies and first-responders a highly reliable means of communication when terrestrial networks are down following natural and man-made disasters. The company is based in Falls Church, Virginia, and is led by a team of satellite and wireless industry veterans.

About ELCA Informatique SA / ELCA Informatik AG
-----------------------------------------------

Since its founding in 1968, ELCA has continually grown. Today, it is one of the biggest independent Swiss full-service providers for business and technology solutions, and a leader in the fields of IT business consulting, software development and maintenance, and IT systems integration. The privately owned company, with more than 1300 experts, has branches in Lausanne, Zurich, Geneva, Bern, Basel, Paris, Madrid, London, as well as Mauritius, Granada and Ho Chi Minh City (offshore development), all operating according to a common process framework. ELCA develops innovative, custom-designed and high-performing business and technology solutions for a broad number of industries and customers. The solutions reduce complexity and costs, simplify the organization, and increase innovation cycles, improve business outcome and customer satisfaction. ELCA can develop individual software solutions as well as implement standard and open source technologies. 50 years of experience and a proven agile project and software development methodology enable ELCA to deliver projects successfully, including on a fixed-price basis, offering customers a high level of certainty in their budget and time planning. ELCA puts great emphasis on identifying and recruiting top talents from leading Swiss and European universities. ELCA thoroughly trains new hires on its specific methodologies and approaches. ELCA’s working methods are regularly reviewed with regard to quality assurance and the company is ISO 9001 certified. The company’s development centre in Vietnam, successfully in place for about 20 years, has been under Swiss leadership from the beginning. The offshore branch has already attained Level 3 of the CMMI evaluation several times and offers ELCA and its clients the capacity to scale capabilities quickly and efficiently.

About Credit Union Association of New York
------------------------------------------

The New York Credit Union Association is the official state trade association for New York credit unions and the more than 6 million members they serve. Together with our membership and the entire credit union system, we are committed to a shared vision in which Americans choose credit unions as their best financial partner.  
  
To advance this vision in New York, we provide our member credit unions with a full range of services, including: governmental affairs, education and training, outreach and regulatory compliance. We also work diligently to build public awareness about the value and necessity of credit unions’ not-for-profit, cooperative structure.  
  
Like the credit unions we represent, we are committed to the “people helping people” philosophy. This philosophy drives every service we offer, and it inspires us to fight for the financial well-being of all consumers.  
  
To view employment opportunities with the Association and/or New York credit unions, visit our website at https://www.nycua.org/employment.

An Experience Enablement Platform is a comprehensive solution that leverages artificial intelligence to help organizations co-create unique experiences for their employees and customers. By integrating data-driven insights, these platforms enable companies to tailor their services and interactions, leading to improved engagement, satisfaction, and overall performance. Organizations benefit from enhanced decision-making capabilities, streamlined processes, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing market demands.

How does Tomorrow support digital transformation initiatives?

Tomorrow supports digital transformation by providing strategic consulting and tailored solutions that align with an organization's goals. Our team works closely with clients to assess their current digital landscape, identify areas for improvement, and implement innovative technologies that drive efficiency and growth. We focus on change management, ensuring that employees are equipped with the necessary skills and mindset to embrace new digital tools and processes.

What types of industries does Tomorrow serve?

Tomorrow serves a diverse range of industries, including but not limited to healthcare, finance, manufacturing, retail, and technology. Our expertise in workforce management, talent analytics, and HR transformation allows us to address the unique challenges faced by organizations in these sectors. We tailor our solutions to meet the specific needs of each industry, ensuring that our clients achieve their desired outcomes.

Can you explain the concept of outcome assurance services?

Outcome assurance services are designed to ensure that organizations achieve the desired results from their initiatives. At Tomorrow, we provide a structured approach to measuring and validating the impact of our solutions on business performance. This includes setting clear objectives, tracking progress through key performance indicators (KPIs), and making data-driven adjustments to strategies as needed. Our goal is to provide clients with confidence that their investments will yield tangible benefits.

What role does talent management play in your solutions?

Talent management is a core component of Tomorrow's offerings. We help organizations attract, develop, and retain top talent through comprehensive strategies that encompass recruiting, employee experience, and talent transformation. By utilizing talent analytics, we provide insights that inform decision-making and enhance workforce planning. Our solutions aim to create a high-performing culture that aligns with the future of work, ensuring that organizations have the right people in place to succeed.

How does Tomorrow approach change management during transformations?

Tomorrow takes a holistic approach to change management, recognizing that successful transformations require not only new technologies but also a shift in organizational culture and employee mindset. We work with clients to develop a change management strategy that includes stakeholder engagement, communication plans, training programs, and ongoing support. Our focus is on minimizing resistance and maximizing adoption, ensuring that employees feel empowered and equipped to thrive in the transformed environment.

What services does SciLine provide for journalists?

SciLine offers journalists timely access to a wide range of experts in various scientific fields. Our services include connecting journalists with credible scientists who can provide insights, data, and commentary on science-related issues. We also offer resources such as fact sheets, research summaries, and topic briefs to help journalists craft accurate and informative stories.

How can I access experts through SciLine?

To access experts, journalists can visit our website and use the 'Find an Expert' feature. By entering relevant keywords or topics, journalists can browse a list of qualified scientists who are available for interviews. Additionally, our team can assist in connecting you with the right expert based on your specific story needs.

Is there a cost associated with using SciLine's services?

No, SciLine is an independent and freely available service. We do not charge journalists or communicators for access to our resources or expert connections. Our mission is to enhance the quality of science communication by providing reliable and accessible information.

What types of scientific topics can SciLine help with?

SciLine covers a broad range of scientific topics, including but not limited to health and medicine, climate change, technology, environmental science, and public policy. Our diverse network of experts ensures that journalists can find knowledgeable professionals across various disciplines to support their stories.

How does SciLine ensure the credibility of its experts?

SciLine carefully curates its network of experts by vetting their qualifications, experience, and relevance to current scientific discussions. We prioritize connecting journalists with professionals who have a proven track record in their fields and who can communicate complex scientific concepts clearly and effectively.

Can SciLine assist with topics that are not strictly scientific?

While SciLine primarily focuses on science-related issues, we recognize that many topics intersect with science, such as public health, environmental policy, and technology. Our experts can provide valuable insights on these interdisciplinary topics, helping journalists to explore the scientific dimensions of broader societal issues.

Hemisphere Media Group, Inc. (HMTV), headquartered in Coral Gables, Florida, stands as the only publicly traded pure-play U.S. media company dedicated to the rapidly expanding U.S. Hispanic and Latin American markets. With a robust portfolio of television and digital content platforms, HMTV is strategically positioned to cater to the diverse needs of these vibrant communities. The company operates several leading networks, including Cinelatino, the premier Spanish-language movie channel boasting over 16 million subscribers across the U.S., Latin America, and Canada. Cinelatino offers a rich selection of contemporary blockbusters and critically acclaimed films from Mexico, Latin America, Spain, and the Caribbean.  
  
In addition to Cinelatino, HMTV owns WAPA, Puerto Rico's top broadcast television network, which has maintained the highest primetime and full-day ratings since its inception in 1954. WAPA produces over 75 hours of high-quality news and entertainment programming weekly. Complementing this is WAPA America, a cable network designed for Puerto Ricans and Caribbean Hispanics in the U.S., reaching over 5 million subscribers with its acclaimed content.  
  
HMTV also features Pasiones, a network dedicated to popular telenovelas and drama series, with a subscriber base of 4.4 million in the U.S. and 10.2 million in Latin America. Centroamerica TV targets Central Americans in the U.S., showcasing the region's most beloved news and entertainment, while Television Dominicana focuses on the Dominican community, delivering popular programming and baseball content. Through its innovative approach and commitment to quality, Hemisphere Media Group continues to thrive in the dynamic media landscape, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance viewer engagement and expand its reach in the Hispanic and Latin American markets.

About Chickasaw Community Bank
------------------------------

Governor Bill Anoatubby had a vision for a tribe-owned bank that could uniquely meet the needs of both Indian Country and the greater community alike. Headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, Chickasaw Community Bank is a financial institution established in 2002 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Chickasaw Banc Holding Company and is 100-owned by the Chickasaw Nation.  
  
We started with $7.5 million in assets, and with a combination of careful management and a fierce commitment to Building Better Lives for Everyone, we grew to over $200 million in assets. Over time, we broadened our operations' scope to empower even more individuals and businesses in our community.  
  
Today, Chickasaw Community Bank is a full-service financial institution that offers a diverse array of checking accounts, savings accounts, investment products, mortgages, and lending services to individuals and businesses across the region. As of January 2021, Bauer Financial rated us as a 5-star bank, and we've been consistently placed in the top 15% of all U.S. banks by Seifried & Brew LLC. We were even named one of the Top Places to Work in Oklahoma by the Daily Oklahoman. We have received state and national recognition through our efforts in Native America and are the #1 source of Native American home loans in Oklahoma.  
  
From basic banking services to a government-backed commercial loan, we've got the products you need and well-trained staff ready to help you understand what makes us different. Give us a chance, and you can get a firsthand view of how we Build Better Lives for Everyone.  
  
Chickasaw Community Bank is an Equal Opportunity Lender and a member of the FDIC. NMLS # 449326

About Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Incorporated
----------------------------------------------

Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Inc. is an American fraternal organization founded on January 5, 1911 in Bloomington, Indiana at Indiana University by 10 college men. Originally founded under the name Kappa Alpha Nu, the fraternity was incorporated on May 15, 1911.  
  
Since its inception, the organization has placed an emphasis on Achievement in Every Field of Human Endeavor. The Fraternity has grown to amass over 160,000 predominantly African-American college educated men.  
  
National Programs  
Our national programs are targeted at developing young men into professional adults and helping to support others in service to communities, with a particular emphasis on the African-American community. Our national programs include:  
  
\-Guide Right  
\-Kappa League  
\-Lead Kappa  
\-Undergraduate Leadership Institute  
\-The Kappa Alpha Psi Foundation  
\-Achievement Academy

Penske Entertainment Corp., a subsidiary of Penske Corporation, owns the Indianapolis Motor Speedway, the NTT INDYCAR SERIES and IMS Productions. The venue has also hosted NASCAR, Formula One and other racing series events throughout its storied history. The NTT INDYCAR SERIES continues to be the premier open-wheel racing series in North America and is one of the most competitive championships in the world. IMS Productions is a leading video services and production company.  
  
WHY WORK FOR US?  
A diverse and multifaceted organization, Penske Entertainment spans the sport, entertainment and media production industries. We are a skilled and talented staff, challenged to reach our ultimate potential amid the tradition and pageantry of The Greatest Spectacle in Racing, the speed and excitement of the INDYCAR Series, and more. Our company values and culture include treating people with respect, engaging in continuing education and improvement, and adding value to everything we do. Our long history has left a deep impact in our communities, and we are committed to continuing this legacy forward.  
  
DIVERSITY & INCLUSION MISSION STATEMENT  
At Penske Entertainment, fans, competitors and consumers of all cultures, races, genders and socio-economic levels connect, share once-in-a-lifetime experiences and watch history being made. Just as all are welcome at our events, we are also committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that our differences make us a stronger and more innovative organization. Each employee is an ambassador for our brand, our events and our organization. Every team member is treated with respect and is expected to embody the “Penske Entertainment Standards.” It is our collective mission to celebrate diversity and to promote an inclusive and welcoming culture.

La Universidad Nacional de Colombia fue creada en 1867 por medio de la expedición de la Ley 66 del Congreso de la República, como un ente universitario con plena autonomía vinculado al Ministerio de Educación Nacional, con régimen especial, de carácter público y perteneciente al Estado.  
  
La Universidad Nacional de Colombia cumple funciones orientadas a promover, en nombre del Estado y bajo su fomento, el desarrollo de la educación superior hasta sus más altos niveles; favorecer el acceso a ella y estimular la docencia, la investigación, las ciencias, la creación artística y la extensión, para alcanzar la excelencia. Por su carácter nacional y para cumplir la misión de contribuir a la identidad de la nación en su diversidad, la Institución está constituida por nueve sedes en el territorio nacional: Amazonia, Caribe, Bogotá, Manizales, Medellín, Orinoquia, Palmira, Tumaco y de La Paz.

Discover Podium is on a mission to connect leaders with more fulfilling work.  
  
There is a better way to connect people with work that they love. Algorithms and cold job spamming doesn’t work—your career is personal and should be treated as such. Whether you have reached a dead end, are committed to advance your career, or need professional direction, we can help.  
  
We combine modern marketing techniques with recruiting technology and a leading white-glove approach in order to help leaders stand out in an increasingly competitive digital world.  
  
Our team is composed of career consultants and writers that work to guide job seekers using thoughtful career storytelling and consulting strategies.  
  
Expertise includes management to c-suite professionals in operations, marketing, sales, comms, customer experience, HR, finance, legal, engineering, product, and design—across most verticals.  
  
Specialties include:  
  
• Networking Strategy  
• Executive Job Search  
• Interview Preparation  
• Career Positioning & Perception  
• Resume & LinkedIn Optimization  
• Career Transition & Management  
• Personal Branding & Thought Leadership  
• Compensation Negotiation  
  
We've coached executives from leading companies such as Apple, Google, Xerox, IBM, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, AirBNB, Netflix, Cisco, Amazon, Nike, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Zendesk, Deloitte, Slalom, GE, Facebook, Under Armour—and hundreds more, including start-up and mid-size organizations.  
  
Our clients have earned promotions, board of director opportunities, compensation increases greater than 30 percent—and have realized reduced job search time.

About Inspire Education Trust
-----------------------------

Inspire Education Trust, headquartered in Coventry, England, is a dynamic educational organization that has been dedicated to fostering a nurturing and effective learning environment since its inception in 2015. Originally established as a Federation between Walsgrave CE Primary and Clifford Bridge Primary in 2012, the Trust has expanded to encompass five primary schools and one secondary school across Coventry and Warwickshire. With a mission statement that emphasizes collaboration and individual achievement—“Together we grow, individually we achieve”—Inspire Education Trust is committed to ensuring that all students thrive academically and socially.  
  
The Trust operates under a robust governance structure, featuring a Board of Directors and Members who hold schools accountable while working closely with Local Governing Bodies. This collaborative approach ensures high standards in teaching and learning, supported by strong partnerships with organizations such as the Coventry Diocesan Board of Education. The Trust is particularly proud of its faith schools, which embody a rich cultural and ethical framework.  
  
Inspire Education Trust places a strong emphasis on professional development, offering numerous opportunities for joint training days and shared learning experiences among teaching and support staff. This commitment to collaboration not only enhances the quality of education but also fosters a supportive community that values the retention and promotion of quality staff. The Trust believes that “Expectations Shape Outcomes,” and it strives to maintain each academy's unique culture while promoting best practices across the network. For those interested in the Inspire Education Trust teachers list, the Trust’s commitment to excellence ensures that all educators are equipped to inspire and guide students toward a lifelong love of learning.

About Moments to Momentum, with Scott Abbott
--------------------------------------------

"Moments to Momentum, with Scott Abbott" is a fun, educational and inspirational podcast featuring in-depth, long-form (60 - 90 minutes) conversational interviews, with noteworthy guests (some famous, some not), that share their most meaningful situations, stories and events (i.e. “moments”) that they have personally experienced - and how those big moments produced "momentum,” that now helps them excel in their profession, and overall life. By having influential guests share their most significant and impactful experiences, along with the major lessons learned - listeners gain their own “moments to momentum,” as they enjoy, leverage and benefit from our guests’ favorite memories, insights and recommendations.  
In addition, an important attribute of the Moments to Momentum podcast - is identifying and discussing what Scott calls, the "bio-mechanics" to productivity, happiness and success. In other words, using these conversations to understand and appreciate, the componentry and connection between the biological elements (i.e. the mind, heart, body, soul, psychology and sociology), with the mechanical elements (i.e. the strategy, tactics, systems, structure, tools, science and engineering), that it takes to effectively set, develop, maintain and optimize consistent productivity, happiness and success: in business, work and life.  
Moments To Momentum (MtM) is geared for open-minded, forward-thinking, high-achievers of all ages and vocations, that enjoy hearing from a wide-spectrum of successful leaders within business, academia, science, religion, health, government, sports, music, art and entertainment. The conversational format is authentic, informative and endearing (frankly, the more genuine and vulnerable the dialogue, the better). The show is appreciated for promoting teaching with learning, while being entertaining and instructional; candid and compassionate; considerate and constructive; challenging and empathetic; smart, but humble.

Born Sofia Scicolone in Rome in 1934, Loren's journey to stardom was riddled with obstacles. From her impoverished childhood during World War II to her quest for success in the male-dominated film industry, Loren's perseverance and undeniable talent would ultimately transform her into a global superstar.  
  
Loren's extraordinary beauty and striking features set her apart from the crowd and caught the attention of talent scouts early on. Tall, with a voluptuous figure and piercing eyes, she possessed a unique charm that would soon mesmerize audiences worldwide. Her exotic Italian looks became her trademark, and her sensuality was intoxicating. Her radiant presence on the big screen made every role she played captivating and unforgettable.  
  
Loren broke onto the international stage with her breakout role in the 1954 film "The Gold of Naples," directed by Vittorio De Sica. Her portrayal of the character Sophia in one of the film's segments made her a household name across Italy. This marked the beginning of an enduring partnership between Loren and De Sica, who would go on to direct some of her most acclaimed films. Together, they explored the nuanced complexity of Loren's characters, showcasing her immense talent and versatility.  
  
One of Loren's most celebrated performances came in the 1960 film "Two Women," directed by De Sica. In this powerful drama set during World War II, Loren played the role of Cesira, a strong and resilient mother trying to protect her daughter amidst the horrors of war. The film earned Loren international recognition and she became the first actor or actress to win an Academy Award for a non-English-speaking role. This momentous milestone solidified her status as a global superstar, breaking barriers and inspiring aspiring actors and actresses around the world.  
  
Loren's on-screen charisma transcended language barriers, appealing to international audiences of all backgrounds. Her magnetic charm and flawless acting skills led to collaborations with renowned directors such as Charlie Chaplin, Stanley Kramer, and Ettore Scola. In each role, she effortlessly embodied her characters, infusing them with depth, emotion, and authenticity. From her intoxicating performances as femme fatales to her vulnerable portrayals of complex women, Loren's range knew no bounds.  
  
Beyond her acting prowess, Loren also exuded elegance and style, making her a fashion icon of her time. Her glamorous red carpet appearances and timeless beauty became synonymous with refined Italian sensibility. In an era dominated by Hollywood stars, Loren stood out as an embodiment of classic European elegance, captivating the world with her enchanting allure.  
  
Loren's personal life was equally captivating. While she enjoyed immense success on-screen, she also faced personal struggles, including a widely-publicized affair and conflicting family dynamics. However, Loren's resilience shone through, and she remained an empowered and independent woman throughout it all. Her determination to carve her own path and assert her identity inspired a generation of women to embrace their strength and pursue their dreams fearlessly.  
  
To this day, Sophia Loren remains a revered figure in the film industry. From her humble beginnings in war-torn Italy to becoming a silver screen legend, her impact is immeasurable. Her remarkable talent, timeless beauty, and indomitable spirit have solidified her place in cinema history. Sophia Loren, the Italian actress, continues to hold a special place in the hearts of her countless fans, who are forever enraptured by her unparalleled talent and unwavering grace.

About JVC
---------

JVC is a global brand of high-quality audio and video products and technologies from JVCKENWOOD Corporation. Products marketed include camcorders, projectors, home and automotive sound systems and headphones, as well as professional products that serve the broadcast, security, healthcare and other commercial markets.  
  
Our mission is to create truly moving experiences and provide total satisfaction for our customers. Using our superior technologies to create new products.  
  
Established in Yokohama, Japan in 1927 as Victor Company of Japan, JVC became a leader in high-quality sound through the manufacture and sale of Victrola desktop phonograph players, followed by radios, Japan’s first “45/45” single-groove stereo record player, hi-fi speakers and 4-channel stereo records. JVC also played an important role in the development of television, commercializing Japan's first black-and-white and then color TVs . It also developed the two-head helical scan system, which became the foundation for videocassette recorders. In 1976, JVC introduced the world’s first VHS format video recorder, which became the de facto world standard for video and spawned an all-new culture of visual communication. Other firsts include the single-unit video camera/recorder in 1984, the pocket-sized digital video camcorder in 1995 and Everio hard-drive camcorders in 2004.

iwoca was founded to expand possibilities for small businesses.  
  
At iwoca, we believe finance should feel like a superpower, not a headache. That’s why our founders, Chris and James, decided to create a solution custom-built for small businesses. One that strips out the hassle, gets to know what each business needs, and looks for opportunities rather than problems. One that provides access to finance where and when your business needs it.  
  
Our partner integrations and our Lending API mean we can provide access to finance where and when small businesses need it. Our award winning credit risk engine help us make faster, more accurate credit decisions built around the performance of the business.  
  
We are proud to be NACFB Lender of the year, Xero Financial Services App of the year and, most recently, winner of the £10m Banking Competition Remedies grant.  
  
Since 2012, we’ve made funding available to over 50,000 businesses, from cafés to car dealers, salons to solicitors. But we’ve only just started. Our mission is to fund one million small businesses.

Join us in achieving entrepreneurship through one of the most stable routes in the world- franchise ownership!

About The Rottman Group, Inc.
-----------------------------

The Rottman Group was founded in 1993 by Don Rottman. From its inception, the foundation of the Rottman Group has been the provision of retained executive recruitment consulting within the healthcare services industry. While the primary function of The Rottman Group operationally remains true to its roots, we recognize that recruitment is only the beginning of the People Flow Continuum of an organization.  
  
It is only by addressing the whole continuum in a strategic manner, (evaluating and considering how people and organizations affect one another, and how to best work in congruence with each other), that true organizational effectiveness can be achieved. It would be a dilution on quality to think that any one firm could expertly devote itself to all areas of the continuum.  
  
The Rottman Group understands recruitment. We understand how it is the foundation of the People Flow Continuum. By starting with solid, strategic recruitment, only then do the other components have the opportunity to be maximized. This is especially true of management/ leadership recruitment. We also (under the direction of a PhD Industrial/ Organizational Psychologist) offer consulting services directed at other components of selection and organizational measurement aimed at maximizing "front end" human resources systems.

Michael McCary is an American singer best known as the former bass singer of the iconic 90s R&B group Boyz II Men. Born on December 16, 1971, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, McCary rose to fame as part of the multi-platinum selling and Grammy Award-winning group.  
  
With his deep, rich vocals, McCary's contributions to Boyz II Men were instrumental in the group's success. He provided the bass foundation for the group's harmonies, adding a soulful and dynamic element to their sound. His vocal range and distinct timbre helped distinguish Boyz II Men as one of the premier vocal groups of their era.  
  
McCary's time with Boyz II Men was marked by numerous accomplishments and accolades. The group's debut album, "Cooleyhighharmony," was a massive success, spawning hits like "Motownphilly" and "It's So Hard to Say Goodbye to Yesterday." The album's blend of new jack swing and classic R&B showcased the group's versatility and set the stage for their future endeavors. McCary's contributions to the album played a pivotal role in its critical and commercial success.  
  
As Boyz II Men's career continued to soar, McCary's vocals became synonymous with the group's signature sound. The group's 1994 album, "II," solidified their status as superstars, thanks in part to hits like "I'll Make Love to You" and "On Bended Knee." McCary's deep, resonant voice added emotional depth and gravity to the group's ballads, helping to connect with audiences on a profound level.  
  
Despite the group's immense success, McCary's time with Boyz II Men was not without challenges. In 2003, he officially left the group, citing health issues that affected his ability to perform. His departure marked the end of an era for Boyz II Men and left fans wondering about the future of the group.  
  
Since leaving Boyz II Men, McCary has maintained a lower profile in the music industry. However, his impact on R&B and soul music remains undeniable. His contributions to Boyz II Men's discography continue to resonate with fans old and new, and his influence can be heard in the work of contemporary vocalists.  
  
In recent years, McCary has made headlines for his public battle with multiple sclerosis, a condition that has significantly impacted his life. Despite the challenges he has faced, he remains an inspiration to many for his resilience and determination.  
McCary's journey serves as a reminder of the power of music to transcend adversity and uplift the human spirit. While his time with Boyz II Men may have come to an end, his legacy as a talented vocalist and performer endures. Whether through classic hits like "End of the Road" or "Water Runs Dry," McCary's voice continues to touch the hearts of fans around the world.  
  
In addition to his musical legacy, McCary has also become an advocate for those living with multiple sclerosis, using his platform to raise awareness and support for the MS community. His openness and honesty about his own struggles have made him a source of inspiration for others facing similar challenges.  
  
Despite the ups and downs he has experienced, Michael McCary remains a beloved figure in the music world. His impact as a member of Boyz II Men and his enduring journey as an individual facing adversity have left an indelible mark on the R&B and soul music landscape. ----------------------------------------------

Futures HealthCore and Futures Education, headquartered in Springfield, Massachusetts, are integral components of The Stepping Stones Group, a national leader in the provision of special education services and resources. Futures Education specializes in delivering a comprehensive suite of expertise that encompasses clinical and educational assessments, professional development, and the staffing and management of special education programs within school systems. With a commitment to enhancing the educational landscape, Futures Education operates in over 400 schools across 32 states, impacting the lives of countless students with diverse needs.  
  
Futures HealthCore complements this mission by offering clinical therapy services to 130 organizations at more than 1,000 sites nationwide. Together, they provide a robust framework for special education, ensuring that students receive the individualized support they require to thrive academically and socially. Their dedicated team includes a diverse Futures HealthCore and Futures Education teachers list, featuring highly qualified professionals who are passionate about making a difference in the lives of students with disabilities.  
  
Through innovative approaches and a deep understanding of the unique challenges faced by educators and students alike, Futures HealthCore and Futures Education are transforming the special education landscape. They are committed to fostering inclusive environments that empower students to reach their full potential, while also equipping educators with the tools and resources necessary for success. By prioritizing collaboration and continuous improvement, these organizations are setting new standards in the field of special education, ensuring that every child has access to the quality education they deserve.

About County of Yolo
--------------------

Located in the rich agricultural regions of California’s Central Valley and the Sacramento River Delta, Yolo County is bordered by the counties of Sacramento, Solano, Napa, Lake, Colusa, and Sutter.  
  
The County of Yolo is one of California’s original 27 counties and operates under General Law.  The County is governed by an elected five-member Board of Supervisors who serve four-year terms.  The County is organized into functional areas including General Government, Health and Human Services, Law and Justice Services, and Planning and Public Works. The adopted County budget for 2015-2016 is approximately $359 million and allocated staff is 1,575.  
  
Yolo County is home to over 202,000 people.  Nearly 85% of the population lives in the County’s four cities: Davis, West Sacramento, Winters and Woodland.  Sacramento, the State Capitol, is located 20 miles southeast of Woodland.  Traditionally, farming and ranching activities have played an important role in making Yolo County one of the leading agricultural producers in the nation.

Patient Data Integration: Connecting Healthcare Organizations, Patients and DME Providers.  
  
Synapse PDI was built on the principle that a Program Manager should strengthen the bond between Healthcare Providers and DME Companies. Our platform gives providers the ability to manage the entire DME process from any location or device, creating increased visibility and control over utilization and costs. Synapse PDI has developed partnerships with top tier equipment providers across the country, creating an experienced and reliable network to meet the needs and growth of your organization. Our software was created with digitizing the processes for both Hospice and Skilled Nursing Facilities in mind, and is equipped with unique ordering, alerting and cost reporting to streamline the DME process regardless of patient setting.  
  
Our mission is to simplify the DME process from start to finish and provide your organization with the data and analytics to lower costs and increase efficiency.  
  
Synapse PDI created proprietary technology with all forms of the long-term care market in mind. Integrating with our platform will give you increased control over the DME ordering process and create operational efficiency via cost and utilization reports.  
  
The Synapse PDI platform blends industry leading software with unparalleled attention to your groups unique needs. We value our customers and DME partners above all else. We are always willing to build and incorporate new features that improve your visibility and decision making.  
  
Our software will quickly become an extension of your operations. We will create a customized implementation plan that fits the needs, speed and goals of your group. Our dedicated Implementation Specialists will lead you through the process of integrating your systems and teams with the Synapse PDI software. Just like your care, we are here to support you 24/7.  
  
OUR PLATFORM. YOUR TOOLS.  
Strengthen the bond between Healthcare Providers and DME Companies.

About Qure4u
------------

Qure4u transforms healthcare. We offer the first fully patient-centric healthcare platform, with a unique set of innovative tools.  
  
We connect patients, doctors, labs, pharmacies, insurance carriers and more with the vital, up-to-date information they need to make the best and most cost-effective healthcare decisions possible.  
  
Qure4u automatically searches and aggregates input from any entity connected to the network, providing immediate access to a given patient’s diagnoses, allergies, medications, lab results, blood types, vitals, appointments and much more. This virtually eliminates duplicate testing, incompatible prescriptions and other issues that can result from lack of timely and accurate information.  
  
The multiple tracking, monitoring, communication and educational tools available through their personalized patient portal – including scorecards, graphs and secure doctor-patient communication -- engage patients in partnering with their doctors to improve their health.  
  
Qure4u is connected to more than 1,500 different hospitals and clinics, including Johns Hopkins, Kaiser Permanente and Cleveland Clinic. The users can also connect more than 60 different home-measuring devices and apps, like glucometers, blood pressure monitors, oximeters, activity trackers and more. This enables remote care management by allowing doctors and nurses to monitor patients at home.  
  
Today almost 2 million users in Europe, the US and South America use Qure4u every day to interact and collaborate.

About Stock Yards Bank & Trust
------------------------------

Stock Yards Bancorp, Inc., with $8 billion in assets, was incorporated in 1988 as a bank holding company. It is the parent company of Stock Yards Bank & Trust Company, which was established in 1904 in Louisville, KY and now has offices in the Louisville, Indianapolis, Cincinnati & Central/Eastern Kentucky metropolitan markets. In addition to its banking operations, Stock Yards Bank & Trust Company offers a broad array of other financial services, including those of its Wealth Management Group, which provides investment management and trust services. With assets under management topping $7 billion and with continued strong growth in account openings, the Wealth Management and Trust ranks among the country's top 100 trust companies in terms of revenue. The bank also offers private banking and brokerage services. In addition, its mortgage company offers conventional, VA and FHA financing, as well as a program follow-income first-time homebuyers.  
  
Stock Yards Bancorp consistently ranks among the strongest, fastest-growing community banks in the country, as measured by earnings growth and its high returns on equity and assets. The Company has been recognized by U.S. Banker on several occasions as one of the top-performing community banks in the nation. For many years now, Stock Yards Bancorp has been named to the KBW Honor Roll, an annual selection based on a bank’s 10-year performance record. Those banks recognized for the Honor Roll typically number less than 50 nationwide, and often less than 25. The Company also has received the Raymond James Community Bankers Cup several times, which recognized the top 10% of community banks in the country with assets between $500 million and $10 billion.

Firebreak’s experienced institutional investment and sourcing teams seek to take advantage of the revolution in financial services, which has been wrought by increased regulatory oversight and capital requirements.

About Roy Rodriguez

Roy Rodriguez serves as the Managing Director of Origination at Sequent Energy Management, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Williams (NYSE:WMB), where he leverages over 30 years of extensive experience in the energy sector. His diverse background encompasses both regulated and non-regulated segments of the industry, allowing him to navigate complex market dynamics with ease. In his current role, Roy is responsible for spearheading the company’s commercial origination efforts, focusing on long-term transactions that extend beyond one month or one season. This involves strategic collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders, including local distribution companies (LDCs), producers, municipal utilities, cooperatives, retail aggregators, and landfill developers.  
  
Roy's leadership is pivotal in managing a team of manager-level originators, guiding them to identify and secure lucrative opportunities in the marketplace. His expertise in commodity risk management, contract management, and energy management positions him as a key player in optimizing Sequent’s portfolio and enhancing its competitive edge. Under his direction, the team is adept at navigating the complexities of electricity markets and power generation, ensuring that Sequent remains at the forefront of industry trends.  
  
Key projects under Roy's leadership have included innovative hedging strategies and the development of robust partnerships that align with the evolving needs of wholesale customers. His deep understanding of pipelines and trading dynamics further enriches his contributions, enabling Sequent to effectively manage its resources and deliver value to its clients. With a commitment to excellence and a forward-thinking approach, Roy Rodriguez continues to drive Sequent Energy Management's success in an ever-changing energy landscape.

About Michael Mina

Michael Mina is an American chef and restaurateur known for his innovative approach to cuisine and his dedication to creating exceptional dining experiences. Born in Egypt and raised in Washington State, Mina developed a passion for cooking at an early age and went on to study at the Culinary Institute of America. After working with renowned chefs such as Charlie Palmer and George Morrone, Mina opened his first restaurant, Aqua, in San Francisco in 1991.  
  
With Aqua, Mina quickly established himself as a rising star in the culinary world, earning a Michelin star in 2006. Known for his creative and modern approach to seafood and French-inspired cuisine, Mina's restaurant drew in diners from around the world and solidified his reputation as a top chef. In addition to Aqua, Mina has opened numerous other successful restaurants, including Bourbon Steak, Michael Mina, and Pabu, each with its own unique concept and culinary style.

About Julian Companies
----------------------

The Julian Companies have been active in the construction, development, and management aspects of the business for over a century. The construction division was established in 1907 in Bridgeport, Connecticut as a quarry operation supplying both blasted and hand-cut granite for area church facades as well as foundation stones for commercial and residential buildings. Through the years, the Julian family has expanded its field of operations to include all types of excavation, demolition, site work, building, paving, utilities, bridge construction, and storm/sanitary drainage. Our company has been awarded some of the largest contracts in the area.  
  
In 1977, the Julian Companies entered the field of Hazardous Waste Removal and Disposal. During the years that followed, we have been awarded contracts by corporations and municipalities, which have included Avco-Lycoming, Army Corp of Engineers, Raybestos-Manhattan, Ansonia Brass, United Illuminating, City of Bridgeport, the Town of Stratford, Carpenter Technologies, Dresser Industries, U.S.Baird, US Motors, Warnaco and numerous other smaller facilities.  
  
During the years of 1980 and 1981, it was our honor to be selected to serve on the Senate Solid Waste Committee, which proposed the idea of individual source separation, which today has become a reality.  
  
In 1995, with the fourth generation of our family joining the Construction Business, Julian Enterprises was incorporated. Over 100 years of service in our industry and a record of never defaulting or failing to complete a project, we remain equipped and staffed to handle all projects in our field.  
  
By utilizing the latest technology, projects are finished on time, within budget and delivered with first class quality in the same character and traditions that contributed to the success of our family owned businesses for over a century. Our experience in managing complex projects and excellent client service is one reason our customers continue to utilize our services.  
  
As of today, the Julian Companies continue to be a privately held business that strives to achieve success in our industry, and provide our customers with a level of quality service that is synonymous with the Julian name.

About National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA)
-----------------------------------------------------

Established by Congress in 2000, NNSA is a semi-autonomous agency within the U.S. Department of Energy that protects our nation by designing and delivering a safe, secure, reliable, and effective U.S. nuclear stockpile; forging solutions that enable global security and stability through nonproliferation and counterproliferation; responding to nuclear and radiological emergencies in the U.S. and abroad; providing nuclear propulsion to power a global U.S. Navy; and leveraging transformative technologies to address emerging challenges.  
  
The Nuclear Security Enterprise includes: headquarters sites in Washington, DC; Gaithersburg, MD; and Albuquerque, NM; as well as Kansas City National Security Campus in Kansas City, MO; Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in Livermore, CA; Los Alamos National Laboratory in Los Alamos, NM; the Nevada National Security Site in Las Vegas, NV; the Pantex Plant in Amarillo, TX; Sandia National Laboratories in Albuquerque, NM, and Livermore, CA; the Savannah River Site in Aiken, SC; and the Y-12 National Security Complex in Oak Ridge, TN.

About Farmaciile DONA
---------------------

Farmaciile DONA sunt printre cele mai apreciate din Romania, având o tradiție de 30 de ani pe piața farmaceutică din țară, cu o contribuție importantă la maturizarea și modernizarea retailului farmaceutic.  
Compania oferă o acoperire geografică uniformă în țară, reprezentând un reper în calitatea serviciilor farmaceutice. Astfel, în oricare din cele 300 de Farmacii DONA vei intra, vei fi întâmpinat cu atenție, grijă, dar, mai ales, cu respect.  
Viziunea farmaciilor DONA este aceea de a se dezvolta continuu pe planul serviciilor oferite pacienților, prin investiții constante în formarea și specializarea angajaților și prin punerea la dispoziția pacienților a unui portofoliu cât mai variat (format atât din medicamente, suplimente alimentare, cât și produse parafarmaceutice și dsipozitive medicale). Astfel, Farmaciile DONA se consideră a fi o punte esențială între pacienți și furnizorii de servicii și produse destinate sănătății.  
  
Valorile după care ne ghidăm în misiunea noastră de a asigura cel mai bun act farmaceutic și de păstra intactă încrederea pacienților noștri sunt:

About Heliocentris Energy Solutions AG
--------------------------------------

Heliocentris Energy Solutions AG is a technology leader in energy efficiency services and distributed power solutions for customers around the globe in the field of Information & Communication Technologies as well as Training and Research. The company's flagship product "Energy Manager" enables smart connectivity between different components in hybrid energy supply clusters, such as batteries, solar panels, conventional diesel generators or fuel cells, thereby substantially increasing efficiency and decreasing the ecological footprint of an installation at much lower operating cost. In its current roll-out-phase the company targets primarily base stations of mobile telecom operators in world regions with poor and unreliable grid-coverage such as the Middle East and South-East-Asia and has successfully installed several hundred systems in the field already. Further key markets currently in development are mission-critical mobile and stationary applications that require reliable, autonomous power-supply over longer time horizons than conventional batteries can deliver.  
  
  
For over 10 years now, the "Academia" area has been offering a range of learning and research systems for fuel cell and solar hydrogen technology and other regenerative energy technology. Customers include training centers, research institutes and industry. The comprehensive range of products and services makes Heliocentris one of the world’s leading companies in its field.  
  
  
The company employs approximately 150 employees in Berlin and has branches in Munich, Dubai, Vancouver, and Johannesburg and customers in more than 60 countries, Heliocentris is well positioned internationally.

About N-Tec AS
--------------

n-Tec AS is a Norwegian company incorporated in 2001 as a subsidiary of Scatec AS.  
  
Since 2005 the company has been producing a new class of materials called arc-discharge multiwall carbon nanotubes (CNT). Arc-discharge CNT are far superior to the more common Catalyst Vapour Deposition (CVD) type CNT, and is the strongest material known to man. n-Tec has developed a scalable and automated process for its production.  
  
n-Tec has extensive competance in the use of CNT in various materials, and is working with several large partners in developing new applications. Current projects involve mechanical improvement of polymers, new aerospace materials, and de-icing solutions for wind-turbines and aerospace applications.

Our Company

Our Products  
Our solutions are used wherever processes need to run automatically. This may be in industrial production facilities, in the field of renewable energies, in infrastructure, or for complex device connection. They are used wherever current and data flow and need to be connected, distributed, and controlled. The benefits of our products go beyond their pure function: they help our partners to design more efficient processes and reduce costs.  
  
Our Company Culture  
Creativity and enthusiasm are positive and infectious. They are the foundation for innovation which is essential for how we do business.  
  
Your Career

4WEB Medical is an orthopedic implant device company founded in 2008 in Dallas, Texas. About Christy Porter

Christy Porter, as the Founder and President of The Jasmine Nyree Center's Inc., is at the forefront of addressing the unique needs of children and young adults with special needs in Kern County. Her leadership is characterized by a commitment to creating inclusive environments that foster social skills development and personal growth. Under her guidance, the center has established a franchise of after-school facilities that not only provide essential support but also empower families through educational programs and community engagement initiatives.  
  
Recently appointed as an “Ambassador” for the Division of Pediatric Hematology/Oncology at Children’s Hospital in Pittsburgh, Christy is recognized for her advocacy in pediatric cancer care. This prestigious role aligns seamlessly with her mission at The Jasmine Nyree Center, where she emphasizes the importance of holistic support for children facing health challenges. Her involvement with a hospital renowned for its excellence in pediatric oncology underscores her dedication to improving the quality of life for young patients and their families.  
  
Christy’s expertise in public speaking and community outreach has enabled her to effectively communicate the center's vision and garner support from various stakeholders. Her strategic planning and event planning skills have been instrumental in organizing fundraising initiatives that not only raise vital funds but also raise awareness about the challenges faced by children with special needs. Through her leadership development initiatives, she cultivates a strong team that is passionate about making a difference, ensuring that The Jasmine Nyree Center continues to be a beacon of hope and support for the community.

About Will Johnson

As the Chief Financial Officer at Iterable, Will Johnson plays a pivotal role in steering the company through its rapid growth trajectory in the competitive landscape of marketing technology. With a remarkable background in the software industry, Will has been instrumental in driving Iterable's financial strategy, ensuring that the company not only achieves its ambitious revenue targets—over $100 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR)—but also maintains its position as a leader in customer engagement solutions. Under his financial stewardship, Iterable has successfully partnered with over 1,000 brands, including industry giants like DoorDash, SeatGeek, and Box, to enhance their marketing campaigns across multiple channels such as email, SMS, and in-app notifications.  
  
Will's expertise in corporate development and global business development has enabled Iterable to expand its market reach while optimizing operational efficiencies. His strategic insights have been crucial in navigating the complexities of cloud computing and enterprise software, allowing Iterable to leverage data flexibility to deliver unparalleled customer experiences. Recognized as the CFO of the Year for Emerging Companies by the San Francisco Business Times in 2023, Will's thought leadership is reflected in his frequent appearances on platforms like Nasdaq Trade Talks and CFO Thought Leaders, where he shares his insights on financial strategy and innovation in the tech sector.  
  
With a strong foundation in management consulting and business process improvement, Will continues to drive Iterable's mission of empowering brands to create, execute, and optimize their marketing strategies effectively. His commitment to fostering a culture of financial transparency and strategic growth positions Iterable for sustained success in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
