About John Deere Electronic Solutions
-------------------------------------

John Deere Electronic Solutions (JDES) specializes in the design and manufacturing of ruggedized electronic controls and systems for original equipment manufacturers in industries that rely on their equipment and electronics to function under harsh electrical and physical environmental conditions – industries such as on-highway, agriculture, heavy construction, industrial control, material handling as well as many others.  
  
We design and produce engine controls, transmission controls, body controls, electro-hydraulic controls, GPS receivers, telematics, graphical color displays, gauge and switch panels, and many other types of products including custom sensors. JDES also specializes in designing ruggedized electronic drive controls from the low-voltage, low-power ranges (2kW – 10kW) up to heavy vehicle traction drives in the high-voltage, high-power ranges (50 kW and above).  
  
Services include: electronic design, software design, printed circuit board and mechanical design; embedded electronic system conceptualization; electromechanical system integration; material procurement; product test; prototyping; surface mount and thru-hole manufacturing, electromechanical and final product assembly.  
  
Our core competency of Design for Manufacturing and our specialized manufacturing processes that produce high-reliability, robust electronics make us a leader in off-road electronics and a competitive source for on-highway applications.  
  
JDES is a registered ISO 9001:2000 supplier.

About St. Jude Children's Research Hospital - ALSAC
---------------------------------------------------

As the largest healthcare-related charity in the United States, our sole mission is to raise the funds and awareness needed to operate and maintain St. Jude Children's Research Hospital®. Headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, we have additional offices in more than 30 locations across the country and Puerto Rico with positions in fundraising, marketing, digital, information technology, legal, finance and many other disciplines all supporting our lifesaving mission - Finding cures. Saving children. ® In order to achieve this mission, ALSAC hires the best and brightest from around the globe. In fact, we were named #1 on Fast Company's 100 Best Workplaces for Innovators 2020! With a concerted focus on diversity and inclusion, we value and respect the contributions of all of our employees. Our work environment encourages everyone to be their authentic selves as we strive together towards a day when “no child dies in the dawn of life.” As we look to the future, we understand that we must be relentlessly innovative. Our work helps fuel the groundbreaking research and treatment at St. Jude and ensures that families never receive a bill from St. Jude for treatment, travel, housing or food – because all a family should worry about is helping their child live.

About DSST Public Schools
-------------------------

DSST Public Schools (DSST) is a distinguished network of tuition-free, open-enrollment public charter schools focused on STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) education, operating in Denver and Aurora, Colorado. With 16 schools across 8 campuses, DSST serves over 7,000 middle and high school students, with a diverse student body where more than 89% identify as people of color and 69% qualify for free or reduced lunch. Recognized as a leading public school option locally and among the top open-enrollment STEM schools in the United States, DSST is dedicated to eliminating educational inequity and equipping all students for success in the 21st century.  
  
At DSST, we pride ourselves on our exceptional outcomes, with 100% of our graduates gaining acceptance into college or other post-secondary options since our inception. On average, our graduates receive seven college admissions each, showcasing the effectiveness of our educational approach. We are committed to hiring transformational talent, welcoming new graduates, career changers, and experienced educators who are passionate about justice work in education. Notably, a teaching license is not a prerequisite for joining our team, as we have nearly 1,000 positions available across our network.  
  
For those interested in making a meaningful impact in education, we invite you to explore opportunities at DSST Public Schools. Whether you are looking for a teaching role or other positions, our teachers list and career options can be found on our website. Join us in our mission to foster a diverse and inclusive learning environment that empowers every student to thrive. Visit us at dsstpublicschools.org to learn more about our impact and how you can get involved.

About Simon and Schuster

Simon & Schuster, Inc. is a global leader in the field of general interest publishing, providing consumers worldwide with a diverse range of quality books across a wide variety of genres and printed and digital formats. It is the publishing operation of CBS Corporation, one of the world’s premier media companies.  
  
Simon & Schuster was founded in 1924 by Richard L. (Dick) Simon and M. Lincoln (Max) Schuster. Their initial project was a crossword puzzle book, the first ever produced, which was a runaway bestseller. From that, the company has grown to become a multifaceted publishing house that publishes 1900 titles annually, and whose seven divisions – Adult Publishing, Children’s Publishing, Audio, Digital, and international companies in the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia -- are home to some of the most distinguished imprints and recognizable brand names in the world of publishing. Simon & Schuster and its imprints have won 54 Pulitzer Prizes, and been the recipient of numerous National Book Awards, National Book Critics Circle Awards, Grammy Awards, and Newbery and Caldecott Medals.

He uses his own experiences as a platform to motivate and inspire others to embrace their own challenges and turn them into opportunities for growth and personal development. Maynard's speeches are not only moving and uplifting but also leave a lasting impact on those who hear them, motivating people to take action and pursue their dreams.  
  
Maynard's impact extends beyond the written word and the stage. He is also a successful entrepreneur, owning and operating an adaptive fitness gym where he helps others with physical limitations achieve their fitness goals. Through his gym, Maynard provides a sense of community and support for individuals who may feel isolated or discouraged by their physical challenges. His gym is a testament to his unwavering dedication to helping others live their best lives, regardless of their circumstances.  
  
Overall, Kyle Maynard is an extraordinary individual who has used his own experiences to inspire and uplift others. About Cleveland Clinic
----------------------

Cleveland Clinic, headquartered at 9500 Euclid Ave, Cleveland, Ohio, is a distinguished not-for-profit, multispecialty academic medical center that seamlessly integrates clinical care, research, and education. Established in 1921 by four visionary physicians, Cleveland Clinic has grown into one of the largest and most respected healthcare institutions in the United States, committed to delivering exceptional patient care rooted in cooperation, compassion, and innovation.  
  
The Cleveland Clinic health system encompasses a wide array of facilities, including eight regional hospitals, 16 family health centers, a dedicated children's rehabilitation hospital, and an affiliate hospital. Its expansive network extends beyond Northeast Ohio, with locations in Florida, Canada, Abu Dhabi, and the Lou Ruvo Center for Brain Health in Las Vegas. This extensive reach allows Cleveland Clinic to serve diverse populations and address a multitude of health needs.  
  
Cleveland Clinic offers a comprehensive range of services, including outpatient care, primary care, and numerous subspecialties, ensuring that patients receive holistic and personalized treatment. The institution is accredited by The Joint Commission, the largest accreditor of healthcare organizations in the nation, which underscores its commitment to quality and safety in healthcare delivery.  
  
In addition to its clinical services, Cleveland Clinic is at the forefront of medical research and education, utilizing advanced technologies and innovative practices to enhance patient outcomes. The integration of cutting-edge medical technologies, such as telemedicine and electronic health records, further exemplifies Cleveland Clinic's dedication to improving healthcare accessibility and efficiency. With a focus on patient-centered care, Cleveland Clinic continues to lead the way in transforming the healthcare landscape, making it a trusted choice for patients seeking comprehensive and compassionate medical services.

Since 1941, 1st Franklin Financial Corporation has had one goal—Serving communities by offering opportunities to individuals and families through financial services. It’s been over 85 years since Founder Ben F. Cheek, Jr. made his first $34 auto loan. While times have changed, our commitment to customers has not. Our customers know us and more importantly, we know them. This commitment is why we’ve been able to help generations of families in times when they have needed us most.  
  
With over 325 loan offices in 8 states, 1st Franklin Financial Corporation continues to provide personal loans, supplying our customers with the cash they need. With offices located primarily in rural locations, we understand the struggles in these areas. We offer loans for auto repairs, home improvements, or debt consolidation. We can help with starter loans, wedding loans, medical expense loans, funeral loans, or a small personal loan to help you meet day to day expenses. We also offer Retail Sales Financing to help our local small businesses grow. Whatever the need, we can answer all of your loan questions and help you find a solution.

About CVO Rotterdam (Vereniging voor Christelijk Voortgezet Onderwijs te Rotterdam en omgeving)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

De Vereniging voor Christelijk Voortgezet Onderwijs in Rotterdam en omgeving (CVO) omvat zeven scholen(groepen) voor voortgezet onderwijs. Met zo’n 21.000 leerlingen en uim 2.500 medewerkers zijn we één van de grootste schoolbesturen in Nederland. Onze scholen liggen in Rotterdam en de regio. Ze verzorgen onderwijs op alle niveaus, van gymnasium tot praktijkonderwijs, op maar liefst 37 verschillende locaties. Vanuit een open christelijke inspiratie bieden we jonge mensen stimulerend voortgezet onderwijs én een brede vorming, waarbij we rekening houden met ieders individuele mogelijkheden en kwaliteiten.

About Kairos
------------

Water damage is costing insurance companies and property owners $11 Billion dollars annually. Most properties do not have adequate technology to tackle the tricky ways in which water threatens the stability of life for owners and occupants. Kairos created a patented water technology system that is designed from the ground up to tackle the threat of water damage and utility waste from virtually any source using advanced wireless sensors and smart water meters that feature an automatic shutoff valve. By utilizing our cutting-edge platform, clients will feel more secure about the condition of their property at any given moment with real time insight and control by minimizing exposure to catastrophic losses from sources of water.  
  
We manufacture cloud-connected water meters and smart sensors that produce critical data to help commercial and residential property owners to prevent billions in water damage caused by leaks. Our system also enables better water conservation and management overall. With analytics from the connected meters and sensors, we can use machine learning to better guide our customer's in how they use water on a daily basis. Our technology is cordless and wireless, with the capability to process critical data at the edge even without an internet connection. We have a long IoT innovation roadmap with our primary focus on everything water. If you'd like more info, please email us: [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)

What services does Kairos Water offer for leak detection?

Kairos Water specializes in advanced leak detection services that utilize IoT technology, AI, and machine learning. Our solutions include smart water meters and LoRa leak sensors that provide real-time monitoring and alerts for potential leaks. This proactive approach helps property owners and insurance companies mitigate water damage before it escalates, ultimately saving costs and protecting assets.

How can Kairos Water help with water conservation efforts?

Kairos Water is committed to promoting water conservation through innovative technology. Our smart water meters and sensors enable property owners to monitor their water usage in real-time, identify leaks, and optimize consumption patterns. By leveraging data analytics, we provide actionable insights that help reduce water waste and promote sustainable practices across various industries.

What industries can benefit from Kairos Water's solutions?

Kairos Water's solutions are designed to support a wide range of industries, including property management, insurance, smart cities, and commercial real estate (CRE). Our technology is particularly beneficial for property owners and managers looking to enhance their water management strategies, insurance companies aiming to reduce claims related to water damage, and municipalities seeking to implement smart city initiatives.

How does Kairos Water integrate with existing property management systems?

Kairos Water's solutions are designed to seamlessly integrate with existing property management systems through APIs and IoT protocols. This allows for easy data sharing and enhances the functionality of your current systems. Our smart sensors and meters can be connected to your property management software, providing a comprehensive view of water usage and leak detection in real-time.

What is the role of AI and machine learning in Kairos Water's technology?

AI and machine learning play a crucial role in enhancing the effectiveness of Kairos Water's technology. These advanced algorithms analyze data collected from smart sensors and meters to identify patterns, predict potential leaks, and optimize water usage. This not only improves the accuracy of leak detection but also helps property owners make informed decisions about water management and conservation.

What are the benefits of using smart water meters provided by Kairos Water?

Smart water meters from Kairos Water offer numerous benefits, including real-time monitoring of water usage, early detection of leaks, and detailed analytics on consumption patterns. These meters help property owners save money by reducing water waste and preventing costly damage from leaks. Additionally, they support sustainability efforts by promoting responsible water usage and conservation practices.
